Prof. Narayanan's class was such a pleasant surprise for me. I was very intimidated on the first day, and though the class was just as challenging as I anticipated, he made lectures interactive, funny and entertaining. He definitely cares if you are late to class, but overall he's a reasonable and solid professor. Really enjoyed this class!

I had Sunder for Entertainment and Media Industries. He's a nice guy and he's clearly very knowledgable- but the structure of the class wasn't too great. He kinda just talks at you for the hour and you read cases and quickly discuss them. The work itself isn't too much though. The final is kinda ridiculous cause it isn't really cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Business Simulation is a 2 credit course in which you get to run a coffee shop. Your grade is dependent on how your shop does and your ending report. The class is curved so it all depends on how you do relative to your class. Prof brings up interesting points that make you think about a small business and strategic decisions. Fun class! (meets 3x)
Funny and good guy. pretty easy. group project is very manageable but long. final exam is fairly graded but extremely tiring on the hands (way too much writing)
Lecture topics were interesting, not too challenging, and just a bit boring. Workload was not too heavy, right for a 2-credit class and fun if you're actually interested in the class.
Professor Narayanan makes his grading criteria fairly clear at the beginning of the semester. The workload isn't too heavy and he helps you prepare for the exam really well.

He's pretty boring although the class content is interesting. He takes attendance every single class, but lectures aren't teaching you anything you probably don't already know. He's not terrible, and the class was a good GPA booster so I would still recommend.

Narayanan has been one of my favorite professors at NYU. He is really easy going and understands the appropriate workload for a 2 credit class. He was fairly flexible with assignments and attendance. The grading criteria was also very clear, which made the class easy to do well in. Our class was fun and mostly discussion based.
he's really nice and understanding of his students. workload isn't too hard or too much. would recommend
Good Introduction course
Sunder does not make an effort to connect to students-talks at you and is pretty boring. Class work is easy.

Really nice professor. First half of the course is boring and you just go over slides. Second half is more fun and you just watch or give presentations. Very easy class. He's also very interested in his students.

the class is easy as hell as i've been getting 100's on the quizzes (3 worth 20% each of your grade). HOWEVER, the guys below be must be playing a sick joke, b/c sunder assigns more reading than any other prof i've ever had. you will only do well if you read EVERYTHING AND KNOW EVERY LITTLE DETAIL FOR ALL THE CHAPTERS HE ASSIGNS.

I love this man. He was funny, engaging, and was very straightforward with his expectations for the class. He realizes that it is an introductory course; therefore he does not bombard you with readings or any other crazy assignments. Attendance however, is MANDATORY, which is understandable since the class only meets once a week. Excellent prof!
Very good professor
He's boring. There are 2 group presentations/projects and a take home final. It's not hard but not particularly enjoyable either...
No Comments

He is not a very good teacher.  He simply reads off of his powerpoint slides which are available on blackboard so there is no point in attending class.  He does not engage the students and, although he is a nice person, doesn't make it an enjoyable experience

he's fine... but be prepared to buy books that you'll barely touch for a week bc you HAVE to bring a physical copy.  he docks points off if you don't. reviews.comment: He's funny and caring. You have to be there and participate, but no tests. only online quizzes and a couple papers. also one group project which is super easy. always gives a rubric for papers so you know what to do. he's really welcoming to people who go to office hours so please go if you have any questions.
Such a truly amazing professor. Explains concepts clearly and easy grader!

Professor Chen was easily my favorite professor in the past semester. His lectures discuss the content of the readings that you've had to do on deep levels, and inspire discussions during the class that are truly eye opening. Do the readings and assignments as he'll respect you as a student if you respect him as a teacher. It's an easy A.

Professor Chen is a very eager and encouraging of students. However, he does require a quiz by 9 pm the night before every class. Discussion posts are due at 9 pm the Sunday before class. His lectures are so boring. He only gives A's if you earn above 95% but there is a lot of opportunity for extra credit. He's so kind, though.

Prof. Chen is very easy to contact outside of class, and very good office hours. there are 2 quizzes a week, but they are online/openbook. Don't miss class, bc he grades participation. 2 papers and a group project which is easy. Take him.

I actually failed to understand how does he gets all that ratings. Most of the hours highly unclear about class content, rigid, often cringe making irrelevant jokes/examples. Literally the WORST experience.

Dr. Chen truly is an inspiring professor. He strives to make each one of his lectures engaging and informative for his students. He values everyone's opinions and loves meeting with students in office hours. Dr. Chen has been my favorite professor at NYU, and I couldn't recommend him more! Take his course!
too much quiz, paper,readings and exam

Prof Chen is the best! The bad reviews on here are giving bad reviews fter just one or two classes. Someone said you need to participate 3x to get completely false credit. You need to participate once to get full credit, and you get extra credit if you participate more. He is a lenient grader, and is super helpful if you reach out. Take him!

Great professor!! Extra credit is available for almost every assignment, and the grading is very reasonable. If you put in effort, it shouldn't be difficult to do well. He also responds to emails quickly, and is flexible with meeting with students. He shows that he cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Have discussion posts and quizzes every week. You have to always be ready to participate in class, otherwise you won't receive credits for participation. There are always a lot of reading that you have to read. Won't recommend.

He has his favorites in his class.
Overrated.

reviews.comment: Great professor, cares a lot about what he teaches, participation is huge. Funny guy too, he's the boy

Superrrrrr responsible prof.

Prof Chen is definitely not hyped. Take him and you will learn a lot.

Dr. Chen is just one of the kindness most committed people I have ever met. He loves teaching what he is teaching so much, and it is very apparent. He comes extremely prepared, and wants you guys to succeed. I loved our discussions, and would do anything to take another one of his classes. I learned so much, and you should take his class!

Dr. Chen is an amazing professor. He was super caring and personable and always went out of his way to make sure that I was doing well in the class. reviews.comment: Amazing and super chill professor. Automatic 100 for showing up every class, and if you contribute or read a passage for the class, you get a 110 for the day. Bi-weekly discussion posts that are chill and no in-person tests (all online essays). Overall would recommend 100%

Chen was amazing and his lectures are super interesting!!! Uses tv shows/relevant pop culture stuff to make the concepts make more sense. He cares a lot about the students and is very accessible outside of class. There is a weekly quiz on brightspace, an essay for the midterm, a take-home final, and a very easy group project. YOU SHOULD TAKE HIM!!!

Dr. Chen is REALLY good at what he does because his lectures are NEVER boring. Makes source material easy to engage which extends to essays, his open-book online quizzes (3 hour time limit) and you can easily gain participation points. If he taught GWM, I would take it. Just make sure to read the source material and relate to it.

Great professor! Willing to help you out if you reach out. Def an easy A if you put the work in (I did not lol). reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Proff Chen is such a nice professor. He was clearly very passionate about the material and really invested in the students learning. Loved how he showed tv clips to show how his points relate to the real world. 10/10

Absolute best professor I ever had. Assignments, instructions, and policies are clear. Very lenient grader. Very accessible.  2 essays one project. Sweetest man. So understanding. Prof Chen genuinely cares about his students and is incredibly passionate about this work, as I have experienced from his office hour visits. reviews.comment: I love the class and Professor Chen. He loves making pop culture references, which has helped me understand the content. Reading quizzes are simple, just as long as you do the reading. He makes the environment fun and welcoming! Make sure to participate!! I wish he taught other courses in GLS; I would love to take him again!! Amazing Professor!!!!

Took him last semester and taking him in my second semester again! He is a great teacher who clearly cares about philosophy. Still, you can get by without doing the reading.

Participation/discussion based class. Lots of material to learn, but his powerpoints are helpful and essays are not hard. Nicest guy ever (& is open to student feedback). Loved him.

Super sweet and overall knowledgeable professor who really cares about what he teaches. Honestly an easy A if you just show up to class, you don't even have to listen and reading isn't necessary. reviews.comment: Professor chen is very good. The class is very in-depth and humorous. I think this course itself is very difficult, I can not learn it by myself anyway. chen can make me feel the motivation in his class that makes me want to continue learning.

This course over promised and under delivered. The professor presents professionally but it's obvious that it is inauthentic. She does rage bait. It is made to be over complicated. She states that she created her book for her students. — yes to profit off of more when it is not worth it. She said she wrote it with AI as well.

Nancy is very passionate however her class is incredibly mundane. Her instructions are consistently unclear despite her having multiple books released that emphasize the importance of clarity. We were also all made to buy her book that she wrote... It is not worth buying the book.

It's not a hard class but she makes it so complicated. Unclear with instructions and expect students to do it. A little harsh grader and she cares so much about the zoom camera angels, she said the ratio above my head is not right lol. she is very picky and rage baits students so much. DON'T TAKE HER CLASS.

Avoid this professor's class. nancy's class has a lot of homework every week and she never gives feedback on the assignments. Whenever a student has a question for her, she uses ChatGPT to answer the student's question. Also she treats students very rudely. Nancy's assignments are also very confusing, no clear instruction was given all the time.

Prof Nicholson is genuinely the sweetest kindest guy ever, he teaches with so much passion, hes super knowledge about everything, which is also why he tends to go on long tangents sometimes but other than that hes amazing. pls take this class.

Highkey easiest course I've taken in a while. All you need to do to get an A is show up and write something on the required assignments. I BS'd ALL of the required essays and got A+ range every time. Classes are boring, but it's a small price to pay.

Such an iconic professor at NYU Florence! Took him for ACA + ACC and loved class every time I went. He is hilarious and passionate about what he teaches. Lectures are long but engaging, and field trips really bring the course content to life. He is friendly and genuinely cares about his students. I was also in the spring play he directs, fun times!

TAKE HIM. yes his class is easy and he may ramble on but besides that Nicholson is so passionate about art history and he genuinely wants everybody to succeed in the class. he is funny and has sudden outbursts, gives GREAT feedback on essays and hw (may take some time to grade). also incredibly talented (theatre) and he loves his students

GOAT. He is so passionate and knowledgeable, I feel like you could ask him any question and he would know the answer. I would be genuinely impressed if you did not get an A in this class. He yaps the whole class, but he is so interesting, his lectures are so theatrical and engaging, I am going to be sad that I can't take his class again. MY KING FR

Overall a great professor at NYU Florence! His lectures are indeed hard to follow at times, but if you truly try to listen, you will learn a lot from him. Lots of extra credit opportunities and just as many out-of-class essays, but he's a light grader. Excited to take him next semester for ACC!
super enthusiastic and knowledgeable, lectures are a bit hard to follow but you can do well in the class with very minimal effort.

Without a doubt the best professor I have ever had. He is so kind and caring and gives so much feedback and will help you in any capacity. He gives many opportunities for grade boosts and is genuinely passionate about the content. Take Nicholson if you can, you won't regret it.

Nicholson is an amazing teacher, he is so knowledgeable about what he teaches and is always so excited for every day.  He gives you the test a week beforehand with exactly what is on it, so you're almost guaranteed to get an A.  The only thing is he's a little monotoned and he goes on random tangents, but besides that he's amazing.

He's incredibly funny, kind, and knowledgable about what he's teaching. If you bring up literally any art piece or historical event, he will have a handful of facts about it. His class, midterm/ final, and homework were pretty easy and I really liked the class! My only complaint is that he tends to interrupt students while they're talking.

Nicholson is very passionate about what he teaches and he is also very understanding. His lectures are a little hard to follow but you can only fail his class if you're actively trying to. His study guides for midterms and finals are perfect and he's funny too :)

I took his class fall and spring. He's very passionate about what he does. Lectures can definitely be hard to follow, but he is a really amazing person who wants nothing more than for his students to succeed. Easily one of the most loved profs at NYU Florence and definitely the most loved among LS professors. Bonus: field trips both semesters!
He is a very easy grader and a great professor, but his lectures can be hard to follow
Two words: Silver Fox.

best professor ive had, you can tell he loves what he does and truly wants to see his students succeed. super understanding and accommodating if anything comes up and is always willing to provide extra feedback and help with assignments. his instructions are incredibly clear and study guides perfectly outline the exam. took him for both ACA and ACC

one of the best professors at nyu florence. i took him for CFI and made SURE to take him for CFII too. very kind and an easy grader, lots of extra credit opportunities. assigns a LOT of reading but i skipped almost all of them and was fine. just listen and take notes in class and you'll be ok. his study guides are literally the exam. love him!!

TAKE HIM!!!!! My Favorite CF Prof in Florence. He is sooooo nice and inspirational, and he is passionate about what he's teaching. Very accessible outside class, and he is such a caring and kind person. Not really an easy A, but as long as you do the work, you will be fine.
Professor Nicholson is the most knowledgable, insightful, and inspirational person I've ever met. He is so caring and encouraging, just like an Angel. Everybody loves him!

Nicholson is BY FAR my favorite professor at NYU Florence. He is insanely smart, knows everything, is super passionate about what he teaches and hilarious. It's super easy to get an A because he tells you exactly what is on the exam and if you submit your essays early he gives them back with notes so you can fix it. A little heavy on the reading.

Nicholson is amazing - if you have the chance to take his class, take it!! He's really passionate about the subject, and very entertaining. I took Prof. Nicholson's CFI class at NYU Florence and he is by far, one of the most passionate professors I've ever had! Great man with a caring attitude towards his students and his acting in class is always hilarious!

reviews.comment: Nicholson was one of my favorite profs and made cultural foundations a pleasure to take. He's very energetic and lively and loves to grab your attention through plays and whatnot. I would definitely have him for a teacher again if possible.

Awesome teacher, gives you in-depth details of what will be on the two exams. He likes to give you the chance to be creative when it comes to essays, but you can also stick to a more traditional way of writing. He is very passionate and quite entertaining. Essays aren't always an easy A, but if you work hard on them he grades fairly.

Everybody around me seems to love him, but I cannot say the same thing. I can barely keep myself awake in classes and lectures are long and dry. However, he's very passionate and is ready to help you, so I guess it's just me who's not adapting to his way of teaching.

Great Professor! Easy A if your willing to put in the time for the work. Makes the class interesting and fun with his humor and acting skills. He does this show when he puts on masks and it's hilarious. Show him that you care about the course and he'll take care of you.

He is one of the best professor I've ever had. He's clear, very organized and he tells you what he expects form you. I do admit that he is tough, but if you keep up with the readings and hand in papers in time you will be fine.  He is very passionate and he will make you love what you're studying.
best professor at NYU Florence. Period.

One of the most brilliant professors I have ever had. He is engaging and energetic and you want to consume a coffee or two before class to catch each semantic and analytical gem that comes from his mouth. He will sometimes come to class dressed up as a character when reciting plays and he does this quite well because he is also an actor. Get pumped
He is the MOST AMAZING Prof ever, Take his class and you will never regret it!!!! I LOVE his classes.
Love this guy! He's absolutely the greatest and his enthusiasm is contagious. I have him for Cultural Foundations I and absolutely adore it!

He's a fantastic teacher who is so passionate about his subject that it only motivates you to learn. Send him your rough drafts before the papers are due and he'll fix them up and you'll get an A every time!

best teacher i ever had! don't miss his class, it's the highlight of my week! he knows absolutely everything about his subject, no question is left unanswered, every student comment is discussed. very enthusiastic teacher (often acts out scenes from plays). encourages individual essaz topics. fairly easy exams and good review sessions. overall: A+

First, I was not interested in Art history AT ALL!!! but after taking his class, I am seriously thinking about art history as my major. He is not an easy teacher, but not hard. If you do work hard, you will get good grades. He is so passionate, so brilliant, so helpful. The best professor i've had yet!
Wonderful teacher. Great explanations, my best college class ever so far! I recommand him very strongly. He puts passion into his work...
interesting, passionate teacher whose lectures are easy to follow, though he talks rather fast. can be quite dramatic at times, but it only adds to the fun.

Professor Xenakis is knowledgeable, but the class is mentally draining. She lectures for hours without meaningful breaks. Despite appearance she actually  has little consideration for students. I want to give her a 10 if I could

most honest review of roberta newman:

she is great, currently taking her and i wish i could take her forever. yes she isnt tech savvy, could get off track sometimes, and loves to ramble, but she is just authentically her all the time and its apart of her charm 

super light grader, cares about her students and is passionate about everything.

I had a medical issue towards the beginning of the course and this is the one professor that was extremely caring. She truly cares about the success of her students and is looking to connect with them. One of the most wise people I've met and the lectures were so fun to listen to!

prof newman is sweet and funny! her grading criteria is clear and although she may ramble a lot in class, it makes the lectures actually bearable as it's not just an overload of info at once. the exams and projects are also pretty straightforward. take her!

midterm/Final will be difficult.

She's really sweet and caring. And you can tell she's a great person. She knows what she's talking about, and she talks a lot so you don't really have to talk either. But if she stops talking and asks the class a question, she'll sit there until someone answers her. If I HAD to take her again, I would.

Super sweet professor, super boring and easy class. There was very minimal content but personally I enjoyed having such an easy A. She's chill and funny and sometimes disorganized but apologetic and makes up for it. Prepare to speak in class like once per session though.

BEST PROF! She always tried to help students improve their grades; she even made the final optional and allowed cheat sheets! Her lectures are hilarious, and she only cares about your engagement. She based her grades on effort, so you could get an A even if you got a C on the midterm. Graded by a few things: 1 Paper, 1 Project, 1 Exam. TAKE HER!

AVOID. The majority of the class is Newman blabbering on tangents with seemingly little relation to what you are learning. Little set guideline or instruction. Lectures leave much to self-interpretation, but Newman will grade you badly if you do not interpret something the exact same way she does. Arbitrary and harsh grader. Favors a few students.

Passionate about subject matter but stay away, not fair or kind. Bulk of grade was final take home essay that was arbitrarily graded with no framework and resulted in low grade. I pushed back and she blew up about it to the point that I had to take up with Dean for a regrade that resulted in a A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love her. She is so accommodating and sweet, and at least for our semester the final was not mandatory, basically an extra credit assignment. As other people have said she does tend to go on tangents but I had no issue with it.
Best professor ever!

She really is a cool person! She loves her job, and she is fun to listen to, but the class is extremely lecture heavy and can get off-topic. She is upfront about being a harsh grader, but it's still possible to get a good grade you just have to put in the effort. Also just do the short readings and participate here and there you will be fine
The worst professor.

I like professor Newman! You can tell she genuinely enjoys what she teaches about and likes to engage the class. She's funny, but can go a lil off topic. Few assignments, but worth a lot, so make sure to work hard on them. Not super clear on grading criteria/organized, but still able to get good scores. Provide thoughtful + clear insight in ur work
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Newman is really fun! I took her for both CF1 and CF2 and both classes were really enjoyable. Her enthusiasm towards the subject was contagious, and it made it easier for me to write papers, participate in class, and engage more. Her class retains its quality over Zoom, although I think that the classroom experience is the best.

I took her for CF1 and CF2. So caring, she wants her students to do well. Participate in class! She will love you and your class if you just show you are putting in the effort. Go to her office hours and she will guide you in the right direction for written assignments. Love her, love her class, can't say enough great things about her!

Professor Newman cares. It is very evident that she wants her students to do well and she genuinely enjoys being around her students. To do well in class, participate. Meet with her about papers. Spark up conversations with her and you'll do well. However, I was incredibly bored in this class. I hated going to class. Pick a different professor.
she is fine but sorta boring (+rambles) and sometimes a hard marker

At the beginning of the semester, I thought that I had made a mistake by taking Prof Newman; but it turned out to be just the opposite. She is really funny and although she can come off as being a hard-ass she is kind and appreciates people who do the reading and participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Generally in both CF and SF all you have to do is read and you're usually good. Newman is a great teacher, really cares, lectures are fun and if you're confused about something you can ask her. Not that hard to follow her in class, it can be entertaining but sometimes boring but overall GREAT TEACHER.

Roberta is an amazing lady! She's such an intelligent human being and extremely passionate when she's teaching her students. You'll definitely leave her class feeling like you've learned so much. You must go to her class. She loves students who participate and question the material they're reading. Do the readings and put effort into your papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This was the only bad teacher I had at NYU. Sure Newman knows a lot about baseball but grading papers arbitrarily based on whether or not you like someone on a personal level is juvenile. Also, she loves making off-color quips nonstop. She gave me a C- on the final paper and called it a disaster. I had another professor grade it and he said A-...
She is the best. Participate, do the reading, engage in her class and you'll be good.

Prof Newman is simply the best. 2 papers, 1 final project. Readingmovie watching for every class. Incorporates a lot of film, not "too much work." She genuinely cares about her students and about the material. Very inspirational. Grades based on effort and allows you to have your own opinion. Reads drafts and gives very helpful feedback. LOVE!

Class lectures are frustratingly random, but tries to keep the class interesting. Very helpful if you go in for office hours and takes an interest in her students. Grade based on essays (no assignmentsexams), will have readings for each class but they're not too rough

Really enthusiastic professor who genuinely cares about your learning. She gives out drafts and if you are really struggling she will do her best to try to help. She is a really eccentric character which makes the class more fun!

Enthusiastic, knowledgeable and hilarious prof. Not difficult at all and fairest grader ever. Prof. Newman is an awesome must have professor. She's crazy in an amazing way. She's always willing to help you too. Send her drafts and you'll get A's on your papers because she'll tell you how to improve your writing. Be yourself and enjoy the class!
Fun class. DIFFICULT grader.

Although she is a tough (but fair) paper grader, Prof. Newman gives chances to bring grades up through rewrites.  She also does students a favor by putting such a heavy emphasis on class participation, which can bring up your grade quite a bit.  As long as you READ and PARTICIPATE, you will definitely like this class.

Although she is a tough grader on papers, Prof. Newman gives plenty of chances to bring those grades up through rewrites.  She also helps you out by giving class participation a heavy influence on your grade, so DO THE READING and most importantly TALK and you will like this class.

Anyone who complains about Newman is obviously stuck in high school. She is the epitome of an amazing college professor. Yes, she's a tough grader sometimes but she gets you to grow up and realize that tests aren't matching or multiple choice and essays actually have to make sense. Funny and sweet. Go to her for extra help! Very brilliant.
tough grader when it comes to papers. participation counts!

So I had her for GSP Social Foundations and while I liked her I hated the class and felt her grading was difficult. I also had her for a topics course and as a topics teacher she is amazing though. Participation= way better grade! Very smart woman and really interesting. Projects were fun and best of all there were no tests.

Avoid this professor at all costs! She is dreadful and completely full of her 'brooklyn' self. Ridiculously hard grader who will allot A's and C's not on the content and quality of essays but whether or not you are one of her favorites! Take any other topics class, this is by far the worst professor in the GSP staff and the worst I've had at NYU!!
She was unorganized. She changed the syllabus many times throughout the semester. Her grading doesn't make sense. When you do the exact opposite of what she says, she'll give you an A.

one of the best teachers here. she knows what shes talking about, doesnt impose her opinions on anyone and is full of little random facts. i loved her. shes a bit of a hard grader, but if you work a little bit in her class and PARTICIPATE your fine. like i said aweseom teacher

She explains everything from scratch.  I learnt an enormous amount of things.  She'll always help you and the classes are interesting.  The only ones so far where I haven't fallen asleep.  You don't have to be on time on your readings as long as you eventually do them.  WOrk hard and you'll thrive.  Don't use cliffnotes, she knows them by heart.

Newman is still a fantastic teacher.  If you don't like her, it's probably because you didn't try or show up to class.  She likes the people who go to class and gives interesting reading and writing assignments.  A fabulous, brilliant professor.
absolutely do not take this teacher, she is crazy and unhelpful, a hardgrader and picks favorites. shes mean and weird, the class is so boring and you don't even do well..take anyone but her
SHould definatly be teaching topics classes for people who truly care about the subject. If you dont have an extensive knowledge of the material before you take the class dont bother.

Newman is so out there but one of the funniest professors I know.  She is late pretty much every day but is so brilliant that it doesn't matter.  Definitely knows her stuff and is open to your ideas.  Big on class discussion so read the assigned material.  She also accepts drafts of papers before they are due so SEND THEM.  It's so helpful.

The baseball class is a joke.  A rather boring joke, but a joke nonetheless.  Since this is a req. anyway, go ahead and take it.  Not hard on grading, as long as you realize she definitely knows her stuff.  She doesn't care if you fall asleep, and you don't have to do the reading because the trivia quizzes don't count for anything.
GREAT LADY. GREAT TEACHER. So smart about everything. She is very passionate about what she teaches. Take any class she teaches -  a GSP gem!

The classes aren't dull because we just look at ads the whole period. This class is a complete waste of time. The first class at NYU in which I learned absolutely nothing in. She pulls grades out of her ass at the end of the semester.

she really does rely on discussion, so if you are shy or don't like to talk during class, I wouldn't recommend it, since she grades on your participation as well.  Plus, she a bit tough on papers. But overall, she's passionate and interesting. A lot of ppl love this class.

the baseball class is seriously flawed, but it is still, in essence, an actual class where basically just talk about baseball, and thus, should be taken. disgusting hard on for the yankees. extremely easy class if u show up. plus she looks like a mix between kyle's mom from south park and the baby sitter from the old school simpson's episodes
awesome lady! Awesome class!

I looked forward to going to this class, it was so much fun and she made the topic really interesting. The readings were also good, there were two papers, and a big final project. She is a fairly tough grader on the papers.

Very nice and interesting teacher, going to class has never been so fun. Although side tracks alot of times, the books we had to read were great books, so even though we dont discuss it, it's fine. Loved her class

She's knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. But, she focuses too much on discussion. If you want the possibility of an A, talk a lot and be able to focus most of your time and effort on this class. Those who do well tend to be those who are interested in English or Art History.

Roberta def knows her stuff, but I personally don't care for her style. Although very knowledgable, she deviates greatly from the syllibus, and I often feel as though class discussions roam out of control. She's a tough but fair paper grader.

This class was a complete disappointment. It could have been could if we'd done what the syllabus said:  examine baseball and society and their interactions.  But, we talked about the Yankees every bloody day.  A complete waste of money
The woman knows what she's talking about. She also has a lot of inside connections with the baseball scholar community. Tons of reading though, and a tough grader when it comes to papers.
she is very kind but relies too much on class discussion for the lesson. she doesn't use enough examples even though she knows what she is talking about.
tough but she make dull material interesting

Be prepared to get contradictory emails and blunt responses. He's very to the point with his comments and teachings, although he isn't that bad in lab, he will disappear on you and you will have the tas to rely on. The quizzes aren't too bad if you chat the labs beforehand but they are very meticulously worded.

Professor Orr is really kind, approachable, and passionate about chemistry. I had him for lab and recitation, and he wants you to succeed and is aware that the off-track professor isn't the greatest and puts in extra time to try and bridge the gap of whats not being taught in lecture. He even held review session before the exam. quizzes aren't bad.

I had Orr for lab and recitation for Gen Chem 1 and 2. He isn't great at explaining concepts, but he made a lot of effort to help off-track students with content in Gen Chem 2. Honestly a little weird about his female students. Still possible to do well in the class if you take him though.
Hes a good teacher he gives us ALOT of extra time for quizzes. His quizzes are not bad either.

He was my recitation instructor. He is very smart, but not great at explaining concepts. He gives extra information because he's passionate about chemistry, but it doesn't ends up on the quizzes or exams. Pretty nice guy, but not very helpful overall. Very smart in lab, but also isn't very helpful because he wants you to be independent.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you end up with Orr as your recitation or lab instructor, don't freak out! It is still fairly manageable to receive an A in the class, he is just a very frustrating person to learn from. He also would solve hw problems incorrectly and get frustrated when people would correct him. Ppl eventually stopped correcting him, causing more confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: no. just no. don't take him pls

Had him for recitation and lab for Gen Chem I and II and he is amazing– really gets to know his students, explains concepts very clearly, holds regular office hours, and encourages everyone to ask questions with no judgement. Can be a tough grader for lab but so are most of the lab instructors.

Had him as recitation instructor and lab professor and he was the only reason I learned anything in the course. Nervous about him at first but he does a good job at explaining difficult concepts. He should HIGHKEY be running the lecture portion of this course as opposed to Prof. Sacanna.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Idk why people are hating on him but I think he's pretty nice and chill :)

orr's recitations are AMAZING if you pay attention. our gen chem 2 professor, sacanna, SUCKED but orr saved me with his office hours and recitations. his labs are kinda hard but you learn a lot. i highly recommend his recitation but don't really recommend him for your lab instructor because of his grading... you may be better off with a TA.

He gets too much hate, I love Orr and if you are competent he will be kind and is a very generous grader. He is narcissistic, but what accomplished professor isn't? I wish I could take his courses again because the chemistry profs just get worse and worse.
I had Professor Orr for Gen Chem I lab and recitation. He comes off as condescending and will berate students if they ask questions. He also doesn't explain things very well.

It is almost like he sees everyone who enters his lab as a letter grade that needs to check boxes X, Y, and Z in order to remain in his course. Not saying that being "by the book" is a bad thing, but he does not seem to have an ounce of respect for his students or their well-being and safety. There is a reason why he was sued several times.

Had Orr for lab/recitation:

-Has a superiority complex
-Constantly (yet subtly) makes students feel dumb (said "and I thought I was brain-dead" when a student got a question wrong
-Acts slightly creepy towards girls
-Constantly and needlessly criticizes Professor Lee (the MIT Princeton graduate main Professor)
-Alright instructor but off putting
Not organized at all, but really helpful if u actually cared about the subject and wold be happy to help

Many of us don't like him, he is difficult to understand. He is rude most of the time, and yes he did have favorites especially his kind. He would be sarcastic when asked a question about lab or something. He goes to fast when explaining, sometimes he be wrong about his answers, it a stressful environment with him. Personally, I don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I have mixed opinions on Orr. I had him for recitation in both Gen Chem 1 and 2. First semester he was awful, very rude and condescending, but second semester he was much better and is the only reason I did well on recitation quizzes. He's still a little weird with his female students, but in a classroom setting, he's fine.

His comments on RMP are not accurate at all, he's a really cool guy who explains chemistry really well. His recitations are straightforward and prepare you for the quiz well. He's accessible and always answers questions well. He's also funny which makes the environment more comfortable for all my anxious people :)

While the subject matter may be difficult, he makes it very clear what is expected and provides ample support when needed. He doesn't do everything for you, which is appropriate for the level of difficulty, but he is always available to assist when help is required. The lab work is challenging but becomes manageable with his aid. He's a cool dude.

gen chem 1 is a core class, so he doesn't really have a say in the way the class is outlined/ what labs you do, but his lab quizzes were ridiculous and half the time had nothing to do with the lab. the PLQs also were super hard and had nothing to do with lab though I don't think that was his fault. he is an awful recitation leader
helpful professor!

This is my recitation and lab instructor. I think I messed up in my lab's final, but Prof. Orr gives me a high score. Don't worry about your lab score as long as you go to lab and finish it every week.
Grate professor, however, he always tell you some jokes you don't understand.

Professor Orr is one of the best professor I've ever met in NYU. He's caring and responsible. His class may not be well organized, but you will gain a lot. A experienced and knowledgeable professor is what you essentially need for passing this course. He might be tough, but he's kind when you go to one on one asking.

While he was helpful at times in recitation, usually he went on tangents about things that did not matter and most people in the class would not understand anything. He basically makes fun of you if you don't know something, and the lab quizzes and instructions are bad.

I had Prof. Orr for recitation, and he is great if you are interested in the subject, not so much if you're not. For those who like chemistry, his explanations are thorough and he will appreciate your participation and asking questions. For those who just need to get through the class, he is confusing and overly type-A about labs. Pick your poison.

I took Gen Chem 1 in the spring of the 2022 semester and had Orr for my recitation and lab. When in the labs with him he was very condescending and rude at times. Also, we had two lab finals, the ELFE and WLFE. We were notified of the WLFE 1 week before the exam and never given an explanation of what was on it. Poor planning and communication

Professor Orr makes life more difficult for both him and you. Rather than initially giving students clear instructions he makes things unclear and then is reluctant to help confused students. If you email him with a question, rather than reading or responding appropriately, he just answers yes or no. You have better luck accessing him on Quora.

Orr is one of the best professors I have ever had. He explains extremely well for anyone who asks questions. He is often seen as intimidating so no one asks questions but when you do he will give an incredible answer. If you are actually interested in the subject he's great. If you want to just get through the class probably not the best choice.

His RMP score speaks for itself. I happened to be one of the lucky few that got him as a TA instead of your typical grad student & I promise you I did not learn a single thing during recitation. He knows his chem stuff well but doesn't know how to teach that to students. Things were quite disorganized overall & annoying decisions were made overall.

I only had him for lab, but he's one of the worst professors I've had. Super rude and condescending and will belittle you if you don't know something. Extremely unorganized and inconsistent. Tests are fine but can sometimes be hard. Overall would not recommend.

Prof Orr takes forever to grade and he never changed my grade on gradebook even though i got the answer correct and i have reminded him over 3 times. He also takes his time putting assignments up and this is disorganized. He does not do things until last minute, which shows as he has many mistakes

Worst professor I have ever had. He's always unprepared, disorganized, and blames technology too. "Why is my pen not working?" Later, I clearly saw him grab it after it was charged, using it right away once he reached out for it. During recitation he said he completed the work at 2am. There were countless mistakes in his work we had to point out...

To be fair, Prof. Orr seems to know a lot about chemistry, but he rarely discusses it clearly because he goes off on tangents and explains things outside of the scope of the course. I'm rating a 2 because this semester he attempted to change the lab to this very time-consuming and nonsensical format, and had to literally apologize for it later.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had him for lab for both Gen Chem I and II- disastrous! You can tell hes very knowledgeable about chemistry but it is clear from his attitude that he is above Gen Chem I. While I understand it is frustrating to teach into chemistry to freshmen in their pyjamas, it is not an excuse for being such a disappointing professor. So many moving parts!

I can safely say that Orr is probably THE WORST teacher/professor that I have EVER had in my academic career, and that is probably an understatement. AVOID AT ALL COSTS IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH BY ANY DEGREE!!!! Very UNORGANIZED, and teaches material BEYOND THE SCOPE OF COURSE! HE SHOULD BE FIRED!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Made a complete mess out of lab. Without the use of a lab manual, we instead were assigned 30+ page documents that have almost nothing to do w/ lecture material. Stubborn, condescending, and unwilling to listen to both students and TAs when they bring up concerns.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AVOID! Makes lab a disorganized mess + constantly changes assignments until the day they are due. Gives assignments on things completely not related to chemistry. Condescending attitude, lack of self-awareness, incompetency, does not listen, and an overall MESS of a professor with communication issues as well. A mixed bag of just issues and issues.

Hands down the WORST professor Ive ever had in my life. Condescending, unhelpful, and unclear. He will create a RIDICULOUSLY intricate and time-consuming assignment (were talking hours and hours for a single lab) give extremely confusing instructions, and then expect you to deliver exactly what he wants. 100% of breakdowns were from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Had him for recitation and lab. Thankfully, your lab grade is really based on your TA. His recitations were pretty boring and not that helpful. He does go over hw problems in depth, but he does not give relevant information for the quizzes (there is one every recitation) most of the time. He is not the most understanding guy either but he is nice

for recitation he was terrible at explaining stuff. he didn't explain things simply and went on tangents and would also talk chem topics we hadn't covered yet (NOT covered on the quiz) for lab he didn't do much and let TAs do more (thank God) but he was not compassionate at all and is extremely condescending so i never wanted to ask questions

I had Orr for lab. He was okay. I get that if you want students to work efficiently you have to pressure them a bit, but this was excessive. He always tells people to ask questions but tends to respond with a "c'mon, that was easy" attitude. Seriously? That being said, I've heard that his difficult attitude prepares you for other tough instructors.

Mehh. All ratings about recitation are true. Pretty nice guy-however, as a lab instructor, he is ABSOLUTELY terrible. Gets fed up too quickly, is rude at times, and often just makes things incredibly stressful when they don't have to be. Should also point out that he's quite nitpicky. (Wear long socks to lab!) Shows no sensitivity at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Orr for my recitation in GenChemI. We always went over specific homework problems super in depth, which sometimes wasn't the most helpful. However, before the final, he made this super helpful whiteboard crash course within recitation. He is not a tough grader and he is very helpful if you ask about specific questions! Just ask to clarify.
Nice guy, knows what he's talking about.

He clearly knew his stuff but missed the mark on what to focus on in recitation. He would usually just explain in depth individual homework problems (which aren't like the test problems) but would usually forget to say which question he was working on, leaving us all confused. If he gave us practice problems instead, it would be more useful.

I had Richard as a recitation TA and as a lab TA. He is a smart and nice guy. His recitations consisted of him explaining the week's material quickly which sometimes made me a little confused. for lab he would sometimes explain the lab way to much making my section always the last to finish. but overall he is helpful and always answers questions.

He's a phenomenal teacher. Records all lectures, releases his notes and extra practice problems, and textbook is optional. Overall Hesam was great. You must be able to do all the problems from his notes to pass his exams. Just do the problems, and the exams aren't bad at all. They're the same problems. HW is hard too, but it's HW and not on exams.

The homework and quizzes ask you to solve 1+1. The exam asks you to solve cancer. Very hard exams, even if you study from his notes you will still be surprised that in the exam you will find stuff that you do not know how to solve and start questioning whether you took it before or not.

If you need to meet the math requirement for the Econ major, take the Calc sequence. Even though it goes through Calc 3, I'd still choose Calc II over this class. The professor is passionate and clear about grading, but can come off egocentric - more focused on lecturing than student success. If that works for you, stick with him.

Honestly, people give such low ratings makes me wanna write this. Yes midterms and final are hard, but everthing on exmas are covered in the course. Apart from the exams everyone complain about, this guy gives the best Math lectures I've ever had in my life. He is so passionate and sophisticated in what he teach. Will definitely take his class more
Very hard exams that he does not prepare you to take. What he teaches in class is different from what is on the midterm and final despite what he may say.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: difficulty of the tests is much higher than what is taught in class. Oveys' class also received less time for the midterm than other classes taught by other professors. He kept telling us to review from class notes and quizzes, which were not that helpful because they didnt rlly match the difficulty of the final
so much harder than MFE1, oveys is fine as a professor but MFE2 in general is just a difficult class
Great professor, watch his lectures and go through the types of question in his homework quizzes and recitation sheets

tough grader b/c of the TAs & administrator. final was EXTREMELY hard but won't blame oveys b/c the test was made by administrator. wish he prepped us more for it though. weekly quizzes but is generous, allows us to drop the 3 lowest quizzes. pretty generous with end curve. homework felt unrelated though. records lectures and gives class notes.

You can take online course and read his notes, which covers everything. The practice example cover every single part of course so that even though you don't take class sometimes, you can also get very high score in exam. Homework is kind of heavy to be honest. In this course, you need to take time and do more practice.

Oveys has a clear passion for maths and teaching but I'm not sure if he's the optimal choice for all students. Personally, I struggled with his methods despite studying and scored poorly on the exams. He definitely knows his stuff but he doesn't do the best at teaching them at all times. Also which TA  you have matters in your weekly quiz grades.
DO NOT TAKE. ME AND EVERYONE IN OUR RECITATION STRUGGLED. EVEN THE TA SAID THE EXAMS ARE BEYOND DIFFICULT. THERE'S NO WAY ALL THE 5/5 REVIEWS ARE ACTUAL PEOPLE

mid. exams r much harder than class notes and quizzes but keep emphasizing to use them to practice. expects us to have a very clear understanding of complex topics when thats not covered in the class. in class he's a good teacher but comes off a rude. good curve but still not good enough to account for the difficulty of exams - just alr

The best math professor I've ever had in my life, period. I'd already taken AP Calculus in high school but Professor Oveys' style of lecturing engaged me without fail and helped me deepen my understanding of concepts I thought I'd already known well. He's the only rational choice if you're planning to take MFE I.

Very good at explaining concepts. Hard exams but similar to his lectures. I went to his office hours and he's really helpful. Big curve at the end. Don't take MFE if you have a busy semester. I spent 10 hours a week studying

Decent at explaining the concepts but does bad at preparing you for the exams. Always tells you to review the notes and practice set, yet on the finals nothing close to what we learned appeared. His 4.7/5 rating here is definitely not true. Even the TA mentioned how the midterm wasn't fair for many, the final was worse.

Teaching wise, he does a good job in explaining concepts and making them easier. Does a bad job in preparing you for the midterm and finals though. Just tells you to study the quizzes and practice problems, but both midterm and finals, some of the questions on those exams never once were discussed nor appeared in problem sets. Not good.

Expects extensive self teaching and assumes strong knowledge of complex concepts. Midterm was very difficult and unrealistic given the time limit. Even the TA, a master's student in quantitative finance, stated he could not finish the exam in time. Joke of a class, considering students are paying lots of money to only have GPT teach them...

He is probably the best math professor I've ever had. MFEII is a hard class, but he really does his best to prepare you. My biggest piece of advice would be GO TO OFFICE HOURS. He is willing to help and wants you to get better. Definitely recommend!!

arrogant and condescending when asked a question by a student. Makes you feel dumb for having an inquiry about something. He teaches as if you are supposed to know everything already and its just a review course or something. Not a bad teacher, but he is way too arrogant and discouraging to ever take again.

Professor Oveys is the best professor I've had at NYU. His passion for math and teaching shows, even at 8 am. He's always willing to help beyond office hours, offering both math help and career advice. After a few years away from school, I had all math and MFE 1 fundamentals forgotten, but with his help, I still enjoy MFE 2. Highly recommend.
Unnecessarily hard quizzes and tests. Will include random math that he didn't cover in class on exams and expect you to know it.
Took his calc 2 class over the summer. His class is great, but I didn't put in much effort and got a B+.

I liked him a lot. He is very enthusiastic which made it easy to listen to him. Highly arrogant, he definitely gives all of his students funny looks if they ask a simple question. Calc is hard, but you can't get a much better math teacher than him.

calc 3 is already hard enough, so take oveys to make your life easier! he is a great teacher, explains stuff super clearly. everything you see on the exam can be found in examples given in the class notes and taught during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Might be one of the easiest courses I've taken at NYU. Professor Oveys is a great lecturer but there's no need to attend in person, as all of his lectures are recorded via Zoom. Super helpful outside of class if you email him. His pace is super slow with new material, which means that it is super easy to catch up! Take him! Easy A!

He made a math class so much less daunting for someone who doesn't like math! He is super clear and concise, so organized, drops 3 lowest quiz grades and lowest hw grade. Exams and quizzes are structured the same as problems done in class. Attendance is not mandatory and he records all the lectures. He makes the class really easy to do well in!

The department final exam really screwed me
