reviews.comment: Hes an excellent teacher. I took him 4 MFE1&decided 2 take him for MFE2. Hes super clear&straight foward. He will always provide u with a basic explanation or a structured procedure as to how to approach a problem&then will dive into practice problems that start off easy&gradually get harder. If u understand everything in his lecture notes ur good
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hesam is my favorite math professor at NYU. He is organized and clear about his expectations. There is a lot of material but there are no surprises on his exams. Take this class if you want a direct teacher who is always happy to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took Personality Theories with her, and she was always super sweet and caring. Although there are not many assignments, they were pretty easy, so do not worry about it! Easy and fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taylor is the best professor at NYU--so much so I'm writing this review a year after taking the class. Personality theories taught by her was the easiest course I've taken. She doesn't try to trick you on the exams and even gives extra credit questions. She's super sweet and thoughtful--and remembers her students. Prof if you see this, I miss you.

Professor Taylor is amazing. She is so caring, thoughtful, and truly cares about her students. I took her on her 2nd semester of teaching, and she did great. We had 3 exams, but we had the option to write an essay instead of taking Midterm 2. If you pay attention in class, you'll do fine even without the readings.

Professor Orlandoni is such a caring and knowledgeable professor. Her lectures are always filled with various examples from personal experiences, research studies, and even videos creating a dynamic learning experience. I appreciate her passion and clear lectures and I learned a lot in class! She's the best!
Beyond thoughtful! A few easy assignments. Truly cares. On short notice came to teach this class.

This was the first time Professor Orlandoni has taught a class (and on very short notice, too!) and she has been AMAZING so far. Incredibly kind, truly cares about students' opinions, and took away exams upon students' requests. A few writing assignments, open response, are the majority of your grade. Easy A, as long as you show effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I adore this man so much. So smart and funny, the class topics were really interesting. A great teacher. Was also so kind and understanding to circumstances and lateness. Made me enjoy writing again. Amazing. Miss him.
He did not like me. He hated my writing subjects and then took it out on my grading. He said some mean things to me as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Love Ozawa. Sadly couldn't get him for next semester, but if you can get him do it! Super fun class, can get long at times but is very engaging. Great guy, just a great guy!

Ozawa is actually the best. Literally everyone in my class was trying to make sure they had him again for next semester. Lot of creative freedom and insightful feedback. Readings were incredibly diverse, creative, and interesting. Also, very empathetic. Made expository writing one of my favorite classes of the semester.
The absolute best writing professor at NYU. Fun, knowledgable, yet not too lenient and knows how to give excellent feedback.
Kind, lenient, and super knowledgeable in just about everything. Every class I went to was enjoyable and he has great insights.
Eric was inspirational, he truly supports and guides his students through.I genuinely enjoyed his class, and would take it again.
arguably the best professor in the program.

For a required Tisch class that can be hell, Prof. Ozawa was one of the best. He's a harsh grader because he genuinely wants you to succeed and he actually cares about you. Also his class craters to everyone in tisch not just film or drama majors which is rally nice because a lot of professors don't. amazing prof!!!
interesting lectures but a tough grader.

I had a great time taking both Tisch Writing the Essay classes from Ozawa. His lectures are really engaging and although he's a tough grader he gives great feedback and you can tell he really cares if you do well or not in his class. Great prof.

Eric is super engaging, funny, and understanding, but he is a tough grader. You really need to read all the material and understand it to include it in your work. There are a fair amount of readings and sometimes they're especially long and difficult, but he's nice and lets you write about what you want to write about.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: 10/10 would recommend. He makes a difficult required class so much more enjoyable.
While his classes can confusing sometimes, and homework heavy, he gives great feedback and is one of the better writing the essay professors at NYU.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors of all time  He is the one of the reasons why I thrived in my first year at NYU. I hope to take one of his classes again, because he is literally one of the most respected and helpful teachers ever. 10/10 recommend

highly recommend for writing the essay. chill, cares about his students, and doesn't baby you. actually made me look forward to the class, though I will say he is a realllly slow grader. not that important in terms of this class, though.
Makes Writing the Essay fun (which is a hard task to do). Very helpful and nice, you read a lot of really great essays and articles in his class.
Awesome guy. Great teacher. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The very best- saved me from a terrible first year at NYU. He's exactly what a professor should be; doesn't let you slip by with mediocre work, always pushes you to do better in a positive way. The class requires a lot of time commitment, but it's completely worth it. This is why you come to college.

Eric was really great in the long run- he definitely cares about his students and will go out of his way to make sure you are doing okay (both in and outside of the classroom). When his feedback is unclear, ask to have it clarified. Feedback sessions with him can be a little confusing if you're not specific about what kind of help you need.

Ozawa is a really cool guy. I transferred out of NYU, but can easily say he was my favorite professor while I was there. Incredibly interesting to talk to about ideas (& anything, really) during conferences, & this is where he clears up as he can be a little vague in class. My ability to convey ideas in my writing improved immensely in his class.

He's a tough, but awesome teacher. I respect him a ton. He's well organized and expects a lot from his students, like any good teacher. He's actually a super cool guy, you'll get to know him as the semester goes on. Don't be afraid to take his class.

He starts off sort of awful, but over the semester as he gets to know everyone he's a lot better. He is as far as I know the only WTE teacher to be currently on schedule, and we are actually weeks ahead of most other classes. He is the self-declared "most difficult teacher to have for WTE", but honestly he's not that bad.
Straight up the man.

Literally made Writing the Essay a class where I no longer want to pull my hair out. He's very easy going and one of the coolest, most cultured teachers I've ever had. If you make the effort, you will do well. He's open to any ideas and will help you whenever you need it. Very lenient on attendance policy and gladly gives extensions w/ good excuse.

Many of my friends found him to be vague but I never felt that way. He left things open-ended and up for interpretation (It was sort of a creative writing class after all). He was never confusing, despite the fact that the subject was potentially confusing. Down-to-earth, pleasant teacher who made WTE engaging.
Great professor. He's very helpful and very open to things students have to say.
I really loved Ozawa's class. He is vauge at first, but is super helpful during confrences! He is great at introducing you to unique and creative ways to write.

He's a really awesome teacher. I had to switch to another professor for my second semester and it made me value him and his teachings so much more. He's pretty easy honestly, just do the work and if you need help or more time ask him. He can be helpful but he does want you to do it on your own. He's really chill and class can be fun if you make it.

Ozawa is one of the most intelligent people I've ever met in my life. He has a lot of interesting ideas to share with you in his class. I have become a much better writer thanks to him. And whoever thinks he's vague is simply not intelligent enough to appreciate him. You can't say Descartes is stupid just because you don't understand him, right?

Look, writing the essay sucks. But compared to the other teachers you can get, Ozawa is by FAR the best. Yes, he's vague - but all that really means is you can do whatever you want. He's really open minded and will give you a B+ for doing what he asks. B's get degrees, guys.

Everyone I know hates their writing the essay class, but he is one of the most interesting teachers I've ever had. If you meet with him outside of class he can be very helpful, he's knowledgeable about an eclectic and varied spectrum of things. Overall, a difficult teacher but one who will improve your writing and makes you think for yourself.

He is the most unhelpful teacher I have ever had. I asked him to clarify comments he wrote on my papers, and he proceeded to repeat what was written and confuse me more. He suggested incomprehensible texts to use as evidential support, then could not explain their relevance to my topic when asked. I am tearing my hair out, it's terrible.

Don't let the other comments fool you. He is about as vague as a teacher can get. The assignments are vague, his responses are vague, the class is vague. Class time is a waste of time. He does not help you, nor does he even guide you like a teacher should. Smart man, but a horrible teacher. And he's definitely not as hot as people say he is.
Ozawa is the best. Great teacher without being annoying, which is impressive for this terrible class. Highly recommended.
A lot of work. Terrible class, but down to earth teacher. Bored.
super chill, understanding, and sweet. great guy. makes writing the essay bearable. nice to look at.
A great teacher, great guy. And if that last poster knew anything about the literary history of belly-button phobia, he'd know that it's as important of a trope in early American classics as whales.

If you have to take Writing The Essay, take Professor Ozawa's class. Thanks to him, I realized fully what my strengths are when it comes to writing, and how to be a better writer when it came to what I wasn't good at. Plus, he tolerated my goon-ness.

If you're an okay writer he reads your drafts and tells you everything is fine...and then gives you Bs...vague. He also read us a piece of his own work, in which he writes that he's scared of his own belly button...totally normal, right? WTE is a terrible class, he makes class time ok, but grading sucks.

Seems like a really cool guy until you try to relate to him. Doesn't like that. Rude and does not really help the students. Honestly made me hate Mondays and Wednesdays knowing I had to go to his class.
looks like keanu reeves!! Hottttttttt!
i don't understand the hype, he is very nice and approachable but i think there are definitely better ACE professors who arent as vague or unclear.
Excellent Professor.  Can't wait for his novel to come out.

I am not the best writer: fact.  But Eric Ozawa is an AMAZING professor.  He is helpful, cool, fun, and really wants you to succeed.  He is down to earth and willing to help you take your writing from eh, to yey!  Definitely a catch when it comes to Writing the Essay teachers.  But make sure you're willing to work.  You will not get the A for free.

Fun, brilliant, and helpful.  Only mildy interested in writing or in essays before this class, I am now incredibly into it.  Made me a much better writer.  Was always interested in my writing, had thoughtful criticisms and ideas, and was just flat-out fun to talk to.  An excellent professor.
I LOVE THIS MAN. Interesting, funny, lenient grader, and I think he realizes that not everyone is stoked to be taking the class. Get him if you can.

Class sucks, no one likes writing the essay. but you have to take it and Eric is great. easy to talk to and fun, treats you like an equal and makes class bearable. since you have to take it, take it with Eric.

writing the essay is awful no matter who you take it with, maybe thats why i didnt love him, he was nice yea but didnt make any of the readings interesting, im not a great writer so i didnt get a lot of the abstract stuff he described and then obviously had issues incorporating those ideas in my work not the easiest grader but you could do worse
WTE would have been god-awful if it hadn't been for Eric.  He's funny, interesting, and really makes the class appealing.
funny guy good teacher knows what hes doing
Great teacher, very helpful and makes the class fun and interesting
Great lecturer, lots of hw

professor is attentive and responsive in OH and after class. Exams are 80% of the grade, but I think that is just how Algorithms classes are weighted. The exams are graded very harshly compared to the difficulty of the content on the exams, but I guess it doesn't matter in the end since there is a pretty large curve on the midterm and final each.
Run for this professor
His lectures are amazing! Just be aware that two exams make up 80% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: EXAMS ARE 80% OF GRADE AND NO SIMILAR TO HOMEWORK VERY VERY HARD CLASS
Great Professor!

A truly amazing professor! Great lectures, very helpful in office hours, accessible on campuswire, clear explanations and fun demos... there's not much better you can get. The issue is the course is designed against you: two exams are most of your grade, not the weekly hw that takes hours, which is where most of the bulk of learning comes from.

Not an easy class for sure, but once you fully understand all the techniques/algorithms you have it gets better. Regev's lectures are very good for understanding the general concepts and ideas but textbook is super helpful for gaining a rigorous perspective. Regev is caring and helpful when answering questions + the class is curved very well.

Let me get this out of the way; this class is brutally difficult. It's the hardest required CS class by a mile. But Regev is a fantastic professor and a genuinely great human being. Seeing as you have to take algorithms, he is a great option that makes the material bearable. The final being worth 50% of the grade is annoying, though.
Algo is a tough class and on top of this 75% of your grade is determined by exams. With that said, Oded is amazing and made me appreciate the conceptual side of computer science.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This isn't an easy class right off the bat. You need to attend lectures, you NEED to study beforehand or you won't understand much. Prof Regev is as clear as he can be with the material, he's extremely sweet and helpful as well. You NEED to work hard to get the most out of this class, but it is so worth it! HW + exams are hard, but curved overall.
The best professor I have ever met at NYU! You can learn a lot from his course! Choose him!

Professor Regev is one of the kindest professors at NYU. His homeworks and exams are very difficult, but this is one of the few classes I feel that I learned a lot and actually remember the material I learned.

One of the nicest professors I have had at NYU. He is extremely knowledgeable and I found his lectures to be pretty engaging. Exams and HW are difficult, but I found that I left the class learning a lot (and actually remembering it LOL).

One of the few decent CS courses at NYU, the difficulty is fair for a 3xx course. You need really pay attention to the lecture and try to understand how an algorithm is designed. Get ready to spend 5-7 hours on this course.

You're gonna be youtubing to save your life, every single TA will tell you something different, every single grader will have a different metric for giving you points, and every single Office hours will leave you scratching your head, because NOBODY IS TALKING TO EACH OTHER. Everyone is giving out different advice. AVOID.

Basic Algo is a hard class, I get it. Prof regev seems like a nice person, but the structuring is all wrong. You will find yourself playing catch up at best. Lectures are simpler than weekly hws, which are mostly about self teaching + youtube. You cannot catch a break in this class, they post new hw before the current one's deadline. insanity.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken, but Regev is a fantastic lecturer and his explanations made the difficult material a lot more accessible. He's also super nice and very accessible outside of class. There is a lot of homework (weekly) which is extremely difficult and the tests are even harder, but there is also a huge curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Regev was fine but the course material itself was just insanely hard. It didn't help that the midterm+final made up 75% of the final grade and the test averages were extremely low.

Heyo! Professor Regev teaches the materials in a very engaging matter. Through his lectures, and his amazing visualization of concepts, I was able to grasp many difficult algorithm into my head. Although I did not do good in class due to VERY difficult tests, I hold no bad feelings. I hope I can find a good professor like him in the future!

Hands down the hardest CS course you'll take in the major. Conceptually very difficult to grasp and homeworks are weekly and require a LOT of understanding so make sure to read the assigned readings and notes over and over until you completely understand it. The tests are also incredibly difficult and super long so expect a very low test average.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Love him with a passion. Best professor ever. He is such a kind and intelligent guy. He loves what he's doing and he cares about the students. His lectures are so well structured that you can really learn a lot. Exams are really hard due to the materials of this course but he gives good curves. Take whichever class he teaches!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very clear lecture, excellent organization and easy to follow. The HW assigned beautifully complemented the lectures by giving the students a chance to not only practice the concepts discussed in lecture, but also to preview the next lecture's material in a very engaging manner: it guided students in thinking from the point of view of a researcher.

Do yourself a favor and run.Writes in chicken scratch and talks unnecessarily fast. If you ask him a question, he'll just ask you right back. Makes things super hard to understand when this isn't even that hard of a class in the first place.

His social media presence is unprofessional, and his interactions in class often feel passive-aggressive and unnecessarily complicated. This makes him difficult to work with and creates an uncomfortable learning environment. I'm raising this because it's affecting the quality of the course.

Restored my faith in Bio dept. He humanizes scientific learning and is truly passionate about the subject material (Protein Biochem). As long as you show up and pay attention you'll succeed on exams, which test for understanding not rote memorization. Lenient grader and helpful outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very disorganized lectures, exam was very different to his claims of what would be there, TA was very helpful and only reason students did reasonably well.

Lectures are so disorganized, especially when he illegibly writes on the whiteboard. Completely and consistently misinterprets student questions and therefore doesn't answer. Test Qs incomprehensible because of phrasing/English. Impersonal. Everything I learned & thoroughly understood was because of our incredible TA. Do not take MCB I off track.

He's nice and approachable, but he's very vague on what he expects from you (especially on the research paper). The midterm quiz was terribly written because the questions were so vague/unclear and he wouldn't clarify anything. If you have a good understanding of the experiment overall, then the class is an easy A.

This is an upper bio course so the expectation is to be able to work independently in a research lab setting and think critically, so don't expect it to be a typical lecture course. However, Joe's super chill and there to help and ur working w/ others around you. 2 exams, 2 manuscripts + HW make up the grade. Learned a lot but gotta work to do well
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly really chill and nice dude. Gives great feedback and would recommend him off track rather than Siegal/Ercan
Not sure why he receives so much hate, I think hes a great professor and tries his best to convey information to his students. Difficult class but hes there for you
He's tough and will make you work. But I can assure you you will learn in this class. Definitely the best class I've taken at NYU.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Osmundson has been the best professor I've had at NYU. He cares so much about his students success and allows for an amazing learning environment. If you work hard in the class you'll do well. Professor Osmundson makes complex material easier to understand and is really funny while he teaches!

Although he gave extremely challenging quizzes and assignments, he is very approachable and always willing to help! He is also very passionate about bio which makes this course (and having him as a Professor) extremely enjoyable. Be prepared to work hard for an A (even though it's a 1 credit course).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had him for MCB I. Very chaotic, disorganized lectures. Left me more confused after class than I was before. Asks way too many questions about complex material we haven't had time to even process and expects us to know the answers to all of them.

The only redeeming quality is that he's approachable. Other than that he's a horrible "professor". He has no clear grading criteria, gives ridiculously and unnecessarily hard assignments to students who are just getting introduced to biology & punishes them for it by giving bad grades. If you like science, avoid him cuz he'll drain that interest.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. He makes a 1 credit class much harder than it should be, does not explain what he expects on assignments, and does not provide enough resources for homework and studying. Most of the students have no idea what is going on in this class.
I felt Joe was very approachable and helpful. He did make the class harder than it needed to be for a 1 credit POB lab, but I learned plenty and that's what matters.
Joe is very condescending and a much tougher grader than the other TAs. I did more work for this one credit POB lab than I did for POB itself. Avoid at all costs.

Every minute I spent in his class or in one-on-one conferences, I felt like I was getting smarter. He really challenges you to think more deeply without assigning too much work. His vibe is very intense (we didn't introduce ourselves at the beginning of the semester because he wanted to learn how we think first), but he's really caring!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super smart dude! I could listen to him talk for hours. He's strict in a way that inspires us not pressure us into exhaustion. Knows how to get our brains going, gives amazing feedback and knows exactly what to say. Sweet and funny! Honestly made me not hate writing essays!
colm o'shea is the most wonderful irish man. take his class.
One of the most interesting professors I've ever had. Class is always interesting. Tough grader on essays but will make you a better writer
I love this man. He truly cares about his students and will help them outside of class. His class was always exciting and will make you actually enjoy writing essays.

Take Professor O'Shea. I hate to write, but I genuinely didn't mind in his class. His lectures are interesting, and it's clear he cares about his students. If you put the effort in, you'll have a great semester. Much better then the other writing the essay professors, it's not even close.

Colm is a very interesting, inspiring, and smart professor in the writing department. He has critical feedback and is tough grader. He sets high standard but is willing to work with you to achieve it. I personally learned a lot from his class.

Do you want to actually put effort into a writing class? Then take this class. He's a hard grader, but an incredible feedback giver and a phenomenal professor. He will help you when you slip and make sure that you are outputting the best work you can do, so long as you put the effort in. He will not tolerate the BS and that's the best thing.

Colm is probably the best professor in the WTE department. He introduces you to so many different obscure art whether it is in fine art, music, or movies. At first, I thought he was tough and despised his class. But over the course of the semester, I grew to love what he was teaching. His challenges definitely made me a better writer.

Colm is the greatest professor I have ever had. He will make you a more intelligent, thoughtful, interesting person. He doesn't take bullshit from you or the world - always be curious and interested, and if you engage in the class you will get so much out of it. Colm was the most important figure I have had in my creative/intellectual life TAKE HIM

You can tell Colm cares about writing and his students. He is a tough grader, but his feedback is always incredibly helpful. Classes with him are also extremely educational, allowing for students to share their opinions openly.

Being super knowledgeable and smart himself, Colm will appreciate your wit as well. He is a tough grader, but he expresses what he wants from your essays very clear in class. His lecture has been the most interesting and organized lecture I have ever taken. He will let you read complex and dense but also the most thought provoking essays.

His lectures are really fun to listen to, he's insightful and very very knowledgeable. He can make any topic 10x more interesting, through your 1-on-1 sessions with him or the class workshops. He would be able to render your interest into a more elaborate essay topic.

He's a tough grader, and gets angry when the class doesn't have an answer to a question. He resorted to insults more than a few times to encourage answers rather than just let the question go. He also uses a lot of metaphors that often don't add to the conversation, he'll just repeat what a student said back to them just in a less clear way.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Colm had to be one of the most caring professors Ive ever had. The class was difficult for me personally because it was so brand new but he helped a lot. Hes also very forgiving, but still dont screw him over when you have schedules with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was so hard for me and really made me think, however I feel like I have a lot to take away. Colm is a really great professor, I was consistently shocked by how smart he is. He's a tough person to impress, but when you do impress him it's rewarding. No easy A, but you can get a lot out of his class.

Very good at giving you direction in your writing when you're confused about how to proceed. He often will take all the mismatched ideas I have in my head and give them a specific name that's a term I can research and this does wonders for my papers. He makes a very difficult task so much easier.

Colm is an inspiring professor. He comes off tough at first, but he really challenges you to come to conclusions on your own. He does speak in metaphors, which can be confusing at times, but don't hesitate for clarity. I didn't expect to enjoy an essay writing class in college, but Colm will make writing a worthwhile and beautiful experience.
Loved attending his class and I knew I would always leave the room with something to think about. Tough grader but I didn't expect any less from a college writing class.
He's fantastic. Tough grader, but a really cool guy. I enjoyed his class despite the hard work and I'd take it again.

Colm is a great professor. I loved his class, and while I didn't always love the work, he encouraged me to think critically and made the work interesting. His comments on assignments are often blunt, but he's extremely constructive during his meetings regarding your papers, and he seems like a very sweet person. I'd take WTE with him again.
Opened my mind. Chose him two semesters in a row. Truly intelligent person who will expand your thinking and communicate clearly.
You won't regret taking him. That is all I have to say.

One of the smartest people, let alone professors, I have ever met. He has such a passion for the work that he does that he makes me want to succeed. After one read through of my essay in a one on one conference and 20 minutes of discussion he was able to help me see my subject in a much clearer, and more interesting way. Simply, he's the bomb.

Colm is one of the most understanding, helpful, and altruistic teachers I've ever had. He's brilliant but still down-to-earth. WTE is notoriously tedious, but it quickly became one of my favorite classes.

Had him for my second semester of WTE and he's hands down, one of the smartest human beings I've ever met. He is incredibly demanding, but he's also really helpful and if you put in the time and the effort you'll do well. By far one of my favorite professors at NYU.

Being in ACE now I wish I could go back! Colm made sure to keep a warm classroom environment where everyone felt comfortable, which really helped. He tends to dig deep into readings-asks a lot of questions in class discussions. Very passionate about writing. Office hours very helpful, he helps push you to form solid ideas. Great class+professor!

Undoubtedly the best professor I've had at NYU. Colm is one of the toughest graders among the WTE instructors, but he makes sure to grade students according to their abilities. He is incredibly passionate about writing and about the class. WTE isn't a repeat of high school English. It's supposed to help you abandon high school techniques.

Colm was incredible. As long as you care about the essays you're writing, he'll help you make them great. Not an easy prof- he really wants you to dig in and make complicated points- but my writing definitely improved.

He's an extremely intelligent guy, but needs to learn how to instruct. He uses so many metaphors while speaking, he leaves you in some other place and you're completely lost. I had great conversations with him in meetings, but when it came down to the writing-- I was stressed beyond belief. And he a tough grader. It's a lot for your first semester.

Phenomenal teacher but an absolutely awful class. Colm goes far out of his way to help his students and is extremely intelligent. He expects the best work from his students, which at times can be hard because of the difficulty of creative analytical writing. He is a hard grader but provides great feedback. Probably the best yet hardest professor
Colm is a great professor. He is always willing to help. However, he is very specific on what he wants and he grades pretty harshly. You have to work really hard to do well!!

Colm is an extremely passionate professer who is very willing to meet w/ you outside of class or essay advice via email. He makes you work and think in ways you probably havent but it seems no matter how hard you work you never "master" an essay. I did enjoy the class but I took both AP Lit & AP Lang and I pulled a B-..take that for what it's worth

Colm is fantastic. He had changed my entire perception of writing and language for the better. I can honestly say that this is the best class I have ever taken. But that doesn't necessarily warrant good grades. He is very difficult and tries to push you to do your best.

Every writing the essay class is painful, but Colm makes it pretty much as interesting and beneficial as possible, helping and educating his students rather than preaching. Bit of a tough grader, but rarely assigns busy work, which I appreciated. Again, he makes what could be a very boring class extremely interesting: I can't stress that enough.

Heard horror stories about this class, and the first couple of weeks lived up to those expectations. But the minute I had a one on one conversation with Colm, I finally got it. Very helpful in cutting to the core of the essays you have to read. Fair warning though, if you are the type of student who hates talking in class, do not expect much help!

i had to take WTE twice during my time in NYU, once with a certain Ms. Bernhardt.  I failed her class and was very scared to take it again.  But O'Shea proved to be the professor I thought didn't exist.  He is VERY helpful and if you talk to him, you will end up realising he is the bees knees too.
Hard working dedicated professor. Expected to hate this course but it's not that bad. He opens doors and windows of thoughts. Take his class but move your ass as he gets booked up smart.

The first thing I told Professor O'Shea was that I had no idea how to write. Not only did he help me become a better writer, he honestly made the course material interesting. He's dedicated, enthusiastic, and truly invested in the development of his students as writers and thinkers. And he's cute to boot!
Great teacher...great classes...great interest. Take his class if you can you won't regret it. You HAve to put in effort to score good grades but he's helpful and fair with criticism.

Thought this would be my worse class. Turned out to be my favorite. Colm is adept at actually making literature interesting. Makes even the driest/complex of ideas MUCH clearer and humourous. I highly recommend him Im bad at writing and still pulled in a B+

He is a very intelligent and competent teacher. He is also nice and funny. He has encouraged me to think deeper than I normally would have. I have learned a lot about writing and critical thinking from having him as a professor. I highly recommend him.
Colm is my kinda professor. Interesting, fun, brilliant mind and able to make boring stuff even compelling. Heard he is a poet too. Nice and sincere.

I consider him a genuinely hard working guy. Very willing to help but wants a high standard. I like his honest feedback. Don't expect high grades for little input. Makes what could be boring more than bearable.

The best instructor I have ever had, before or since. Extremely intelligent and personable. Everyone in my class enjoyed having him. Patient in class and during meetings, and very wiling to work outside of class hours. A warning to latecomers though: he gets upset even if you come one minute late. Tardiness is a good way to get on his bad side.

My opinion might be biased, seeing as I love writing & literature, but I think Colm is creative in his teaching style, very accessible for answering questions, and also very relatable. He's never pejorative, and works easily with all genres of students. His assigned essays are interesting and really, so is he. Young, fun, Irish, and yes, cute.
He is pretty good. very smart himself so expects you to get it quickly. Very helpful when you get to know him. Can't understand negative comments as he is good. I'd take him again.

He was alright, but the course material is boring in the first place and he isn't the nicest person. He can be very unclear about assignments, though his one on one meetings were helpful. Participate a lot. If I could take this class over, I would try a different professor.
He can teach ok but this is one boring abstract course no matter what. Liked his wit.  he's honest with grading essay and is very helpful if you need him to explain.
I found him excellent. Interesting and good humour. Demanding but helpful. Take him if you can.

I had Colm for Writing the Essay in the fall semester of my freshman year. While I thought he was an okay professor, I know MANY ohters who had problems. He is extremely unclear. This is a VERY abstract class so it is important to have someone to explain things well. also he was very rude at times and laughed at students or left mean comments.

best. professor. ever. for writing the essay at least. he makes the most boring, horrible required course seem fun, and he's a fair grader. he leaves constructive comments on all your assignments and will meet with you of class to help you.

does not help when the students face difficulty nor reframes teaching despite clear class wide confusion. Gives confusing power points with no way to revisit in class discussions because there are no notes or post class videos. Does not teach in chronological order and assumes that the class is filled with history majors when no one even LIKES it.
She was late to every class, readings were rarely relevant to those classes, when we even had access to them.  She simply couldn't function.
doesn't follow syllabus, assignments arent graded on time, difficulty understanding her
run pls run

This class was incredibly boring and a waste of time. We did not learn anything, professor was late every now and then and you could just tell no one really wanted to be there. Only good thing is that it's an absolutely easy A class that has few assignments but they are all easy and don't take long to finish. Also we tended to end class early A LOT
this class was completely reliant on the TA's, TA's stepped in to complete the class, it was so disorganized, but learned a lot in the end. would not recommend for cultures and contexts tbh

-do not take this class there are so many better core classes
-lots of memorization
- 2 exams plus a 10-page research paper 
-very anxious, dismissive when it came to questions, very all over the place, unorganized 
-lecture slides are not informative, very vague, doesn't provide many details
-no curve on exams
-  content is confusing/specific
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took Is Spanish 1 Language? last semester and it was easily the worst class I've taken at NYU. Classes were cancelled every other week, the times we did have class she either showed up late or ended extremely early. Only received legitimate feedback on one of 5 papers/presentations. NYU is expensive, and she didn't deliver a quality class. Skip!

"Is Spanish 1 Language?" and Prof Pearce were disasters. Worst class I've taken and not because of the subject. Extremely disorganized lectures, unclear assignments/grading, and uncomfortable class discussions. Kind/lenient but incredibly anxious professor, stuttered, broken Spanish, late each class, cut class early, and was never accessible.
Not good

Took for a honors seminar -- was pass fail, not a class to be fair Brought in some cool guests but otherwise an annoying professor. Always said to email her etc but was uncommunicative if you did reach out. Didn't record lectures or send out reliable announcements so after lecture had no reference for work. Was unable to establish a friendly tone

Terrible teacher. Anxious and unconfident when she speaks, yet is rude if you ask her about something you dont understand. She's unorganized, which is especially annoying in a HISTORY class. There is very heavy reading required, and if you want to know what is going on at all in class, you need to read everything. There are three difficult essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I'm sorry to say it but one of the worst classes I have taken at NYU. There aren't that many assignments and the professor never hands back any grades, so the final grade at the end of the semester kind of just comes as a shock. Classes are boring, and the only work is heavy reading, essays and group presentations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Pearce is extremely anxious, unclear, and unresponsive. She never hands anything back. No idea what my grade is. Generally terrible professor. Extremley boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Pearce is the best professor ever at NYU! Very engaged in the lectures and extremely knowledgable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Pearce is very enthusiastic about her work and that translates into her class discussions. She is truly into letting her students run the discussions - which is really what a seminar class should be doing. Just do your readings and speak your mind -- your grades will reflect your effort. Good professor overall.

She is very kowledgable but she treats her stuents like babies and is extremely unhelpful if you need help. On the first day of class she said something along the lines of "um many of you don't know this but blackboard is a very helpful tool in that I can see exactly who opened what document and based on that I know who should talk in class today"

Had him for gen chem 1 and gen chem 2 recitation. genuinely, the best recitation section leader ever. we went through lots of practice problems which helped me prepare for the exams and quizzes. extremely accessible outside of class he'd email us every monday what his office hours were for the week. also really funny and made an 8am bearable. #yolo
No words needed, Great professor!

love this man. kind and super accessible outside of recitation. ask him about 67 (he has a 67 periodic table christmas shirt). genuinely wants his students to succeed. only problem is his recitations are super hard to get into

I am honestly surprised how he has not won the best professor award at NYU yet. He's an extremely funny and kind hearted professor who makes the lectures funny and engaging, making it easier to learn the topics. If you are a chem/biochem major, you are missing out if you have not taken him yet. The ratings speak for itself.

Yoel is the best. He is always available for help outside of class and genuinely cares about all of his students and wants them to learn and succeed. He is so funny and kind and always makes all of his students feel comfortable to ask questions in class. Highly recommend this FYS and Yoel as a professor

Yoel's the best FYSEM professor. He's so easy to reach for help outside of class, & every class is less about DNA content & more about group discussion. His class environment is easy going and light hearted, you don't need to be a chem major to enjoy this class. He's genuinely so kind, funny, and encouraging. I truly can't recommend him enough.
What can I say? Just look at the ratings and the feedback from other students. Such a great professor.

Very chill and funny professor, you'd regret not taking him. I had him for CHEM-UA 126 recitation and he is very accessible outside of class and has a great love for chemistry. In the beginning we were all very silent, but that quickly changed to a very talkative and engaging class. He gives us practice problems to help us practice the material.

He is a very chill dude that cares about his students. He will go over exactly what is on the recitations quizzes to help you excel in it. He provides practices problems that reflects what's on the actual exam. Overall a very great person AND instructor.

Had him for Gen chem 1 Recitation and Yoel is very chill. He will in a sense "get you right" for the recitation quizzes as hes not exactly your enemy. However the only enemy in chemistry is yourself if your not prepared for recitation and it will show. He is accessible outside class offering custom office hours, but he will not baby you at all.

Yoel cares a lot for his students and does what he can to ensure they will do well in the course. During recitation he answers questions well and prepares you for the quiz. He also makes himself very available to students outside of class and provides many helpful resources. He is extremely knowledgeable and a great instructor. Highly recommend!

Took his Structural DNA nanotech class and thought it was great. Attendance plays a huge role in your final grade. He rambles sometimes and its difficult to understand what the main points are. But he had concise notes and the textbook was helpful. For exams, he listed the content pretty clearly. He had plenty of office hours. Funny guy.

Yoel "#YOLO" Ohayon is a national treasure who should be protected at all costs. He is a great teacher who makes sure that students fully understand the content necessary for exams. If you are lucky enough to get into his chemistry recitation, you will be very happy and succeed. He might use one of your extra meal swipes.

Experimental Biochem lab with Yoel is just vibes. Chill and play music while you do some basic experiments. if you've already worked in a lab before I guarantee you already know 90% of what's needed. Very lenient when grading reports too.

Just take this class. Even if you are not interested in Nanotechnology, a lot of the concepts learned will help you in your biochemistry/medicine career. The grading is straight forward, and the quizzes are basically a free 20 points. He does review sessions where he basically tells you what's on the exams, so take advantage. YOLO.
Just take him.

Yolo is such a funny and chill prof. He actively gets us to participate and ask questions. He takes late HW and tells u what to study for. (+he will go over similar questions that are in the quiz to help u prepare) He's responsive to emails & will answer any questions u have in class/during office hours.
Shame I can't take him for Gen Chem 2 :[

Ohayon is truly the best recitation instructor at NYU. On top of being hilarious and just an icon he is also incredibly helpful at explaining difficult concepts and is very accessible outside of class. He is also extremely helpful when prepping for your weekly quizzes and for exams, will tell you what you should focus on when studying. Love him!
he's alright
This guy is so awesome

YOLO is the best! He's so funny and actually made recitation something to look forward to. He lets you know what's on the quizzes at the end and makes it very easy to pass them, and gives a lot of good practice. He also sends out a lot of good online material to study. TAKE HIM!
The goat himself

Yoel is a great professor who is clear and to the point about his material. I had him for Gen Chem Recitation and each week he went over relevant problems in relation to our quizzes. With Yoel, it is possible to come to class without knowing what the quiz is even on because he adequately prepares you for it the entire class!!
Extremely carefree and easy to get along with
Really good
Great professor, you can tell he wants his students to do well
He is a great professor. I took him for Chemistry recitation and he was very helpful. He is accessible outside of the class and goes over relevant practice problems.
Always has office hours and is willing to help out. In recitation we go over exactly what will be on the quiz. Overall a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Yoel for Chem Recitation and I loved him! Gave super good practice for all of the recitation quizzes and exams, and I actually looked forward to going, whereas a lot of my friends who didn't have him felt their recitations were a waste of time. He explains things pretty thoroughly and is extremely funny!
He's a really funny guy and very knowledgeable in chemistry, will help with all your problems.
Yoel slays all day

Best recitation prof for gen chem. Very accessible and an overall funny guy. Made my Friday 8am recitation worth coming to. He was very helpful on success in the weekly quizzes and helped clarify a lot of concepts. Would def recommend toughing out an early Friday recitation just to have him.

He's phenomenal! (Hi Yolo!) Super caring, understanding, and sweet. He is willing to go over chemistry questions as many times as you'd like and really cares about student success. He's also super patient and never gets angry. Definitely take him for recitation, he is hilarious and really lightens up everyone's mood. Dr Yolo for the win!!! :)

Yolo is the best professor out there! Had him for recitation, and he made the gen chem experience so much better. He's so chill and gives lots of good practice for quizzes. TAKE HIM if you get the chance!! You won't regret it.
Necessary to take for a simple and effective first year gen chem, there is no one better than Ohayon.

This dude for sure writes his own reviews because theres no way people actually think this highly of him. He's alright. He's good. Not the highest rated prof at NYU... let's be for real. He's kind of annoying and nitpicky, but explains things clearly if you ask.

I had Prof. Ohayon as my recitation instructor for both Gen Chem I and II. It was a lot of fun to be in his recitation! He's a great person and is happy to go over any questions you have during recitation or office hours. He went over practice problems that helped us prepare for the exams/quizzes and gave really helpful explanations and advice!

A fascinating course on DNA nanotechnology taught by the chill and comedic Professor Yoel. Engaging lectures, no textbook needed. Use unstuckstudy AI and other study tools to ace this super interesting class.
Yoel is actually one of the best professors that I have ever had at NYU.

I highly recommend his course. I take biochem 2 this summer and Yoel is our recitation instructor. We all know how painful biochem can be sometimes, but it is not the case at all this semester. Yoel makes the material clear and ensures we know what's expected of us, and he's always approachable, especially in emails.
A new field of chemistry, will certainly refresh your idea about DNA. Chill and fun course environment, and you can always reach Yoel at nearly anytime.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Yoel is an awesome instructor who cares a lot about his students' success. He is very accessible outside of class and always willing to lend a helping hand. He held multiple zoom sessions over the weekends to help us prepare for exams and made a difficult class enjoyable with his humor. He's definitely one of the best professors I've had at NYU
Involved, approachable, competent and patient.
Keep showing a playful attitude towards his lecture, disorganized in his logistics (uses ambiguous words in assignments and constantly forgets to change deadlines). Awful experience with him.

Professor Ohayon was the best professor I had this semester. During recitation he helped us be more comfortable with the confusing topics of the course. There is a quiz at the end of every recitation and he would give us similar questions to practice that are on the quizzes. He is also really funny and easily accessible outside of class.
Yolo is best Professor I have ever met so far at NYU. Just follow whatever he told you to do and you will get A easily for sure.
Loved having him as a recitation instructor. He's very fun and will go over plenty of practice problems from lecture. Also super accessible outside of class and is overall a great teacher.
I had Yoel  Chemistry recitation TA. He is willing to teach us and provides numerous practice questions!
Amazing professor.

I have Prof. Ohayon for the Freshman Seminar class, specifically, the DNA Nanotech. Seminar and I ended up with an A. Prof. Ohayon is really chill and nice, the class wasn't stressful at all, compared with other classes it's more like a chat-with-professor thing. In total, I had 3 big writing assignments, as long as you finish them you are an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have Yoel for Gen Chem I & II recitation and also Gen Chem II lab. He is super nice and willing to answer students' questions (the same in the lab!!!). He also has a lot of office hours. I feel super lucky to have him for my Gen chem study. Take him if you can!!

Yoel is a great instructor! He is very very intimidating to some, but he's very funny and helpful, and is helpful to explain any concept in a thorough way. If you get Yoel as your professor, you should feel very lucky!
HORRIBLE. Is rude and unhelpful. Will not answer your questions if you have him for lab. Hes given me the wrong answers to questions Ive asked him.

Yoel is so funny and chill. Best recitation prof he will save your grade. You will always get 100% on hw and he will give practice problems before the quiz that are exactly like the quiz. He actually knows his students and I highly recommend

He is really nice. A lot of practice problems are sent to you. You can do it or not. It totally depends on you. He answers every question in recitation no matter it is stupid or hard. For HW, he is so chill about it. Just put in the effort and do your best, you gonna get an A. What's more, he has looots of office hours. Just throw questions on him!

I don't know what else to say besides the fact that Yoel is amazing. He is chill and comical, yet (somehow) great at teaching DNA nanotechnology (I HIGHLY recommend this class if you want to know more about the instruction manual for life, a.k.a. DNA). That being said, if you want to work in his lab, it is slightly disorganized, so be prepared.
Yoel is a really great guy and teacher. I totally recommend.
Yoel is a great instructor. Though he is difficult, he makes chemistry fun!

He gave me 3 points back which definitely helped so much. I miswrote an answer even though I did the conceptual work right and wrote it on the side, but just wrote it in the answer box wrong. Like god bless. I appreciate him so much. Definitely, if you have him, you can get points back. Make sure to fight! Every point counts.

Yoel is a character, to say the least. He gives out quiz questions before the quiz itself and will go over the answers to them as well. Great recitation leader for someone who is looking to boost their gpa, but he may not be the best for long term retention of the material if you are only relying on the recitation.
Great recitation instructor! Helps you succeed on exams and quizzes, and knows all the material very well. Best instructor to sign up for!

If you want an easy TA take Yoel. You'll literally get 100s on all the quizzes. However if you care about actually learning something do not take him. He can be condescending and rude but he's pretty chill and laid back

If you're looking for an "easy" professor than Yoel is definitely for you. However, take note that while he may be "easy" this comes to bite you in the ass for exams. Yoel does not answer questions, he is condescending, and sits on his phone the entire recitation. I would argue that Yoel is one of the worst professors at NYU. I wouldn't take him.
Knows the material well, looking to make sure his students do well. Has a great time but also teaches well. Must take!!!
His grading structure and class structure is random and does not play out fairly. Avoid taking any of his classes.
I would recommend to take Yoel for the recitation sections for both Chem1 and Chem2. He was very helpful in giving us practice questions to prepare us for the exams.

Yoel is actually hilarious, the perfect balance of a relaxed class environment and promoting success. I was in his gen chem 1 and 2 recitation classes and absolutely would recommend him to all future students. He was always able to answer any questions and was highly accessible through email and various office hours held throughout the weeks.

Yoel is the bomb. com- though his humorous antics may not be for everyone, if you speak up in class with specific questions you will absolutely have your questions addressed. He makes time for office hours despite being crazy busy, and made every recitation fun. Never a dull moment with Yoel.
Yoel is a character. A great one. He will teach you what you need to know and make coming to class fun. He is extremely funny. He is very unique, you'll love him.

Yoel calls himself an entertainer, which explains why he is always making chemistry jokes. He very good-humored and approachable, and his class is enjoyable because of it. It is easy to ask him questions and he has the ability to make convoluted concepts clearer. He is also highly accessible outside of classes through office hours and by email.

Yoel is funny and brings a light to Gen Chem that is encouraging and relieving. He is always holding office hours, and he walks you through questions that are likely to come up on quizzes and exams. His humor can be polarizing, but underneath, it is clear that he genuinely cares about chemistry and his students. Would absolutely take again!

Yoel is a unlike any professor I've had. He is funny, caring, involved and an all around genuine instructor. He helps whenever you ask and has a ton of dad jokes. He presents the material in a way that you are able to understand it. I came back to school after many years off and he helps me feel no different than anyone else. Would deff take again!
Yoel is the best recitation instructor for Gen Chem 1 & 2 you can find! He is amazing at preparing you for exams and recitation quizzes. He's very helpful during office hours.

He is more than professor. You can reach and talk to him anytime and anyplace. He gives great lectures notes before lectures and hand it to you. He is very Gentle. He teaches labs too. He sends pre and post lab by email and you write them . I saved my lab book because it is expensive. Im still taking his class this semester. A+ Take him for sure

Yoel is frustrating. He is dismissive of questions, has told me outright "Don't take chemistry," expects instant understanding from the students, and just reads off of the lecture notes he gives to us. He gives you 10/10 for just handing in the homework and provides no feedback. Grading criteria is opaque. Never take a class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the best: had him as TA for both gen chem I and II. always gives the best advice for quizzes in recitation on Friday cares a lot about his students, our sleep, how we are, our grades. the funniest guy has LOTS of office hours and he'll tell you whenever he has via email every time, and he'll be incredibly helpful (in rec and office hours)

Yoel is the rare NYU science professor who cares for his students. DNA Nanotech isn't easy and his lectures can be scattered, but he does everything he can to help you understand both outside of lecture and in recitation. He can be a tough grader on exams, but he literally tells you what concepts will be on the exam during lecture - go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Yoel is awesome, and the best TA in Gen Chem. I strongly recommend taking him. Just be warned: he'll sometimes tell everyone to stop what they're doing in the lab to tell a bad dad joke.

Yoel is the best TA in all of General Chemistry, and probably in all of NYU. He cares about all of his students and teaches only towards their success! He gives excellent tips for quizzes and exams, and makes chemistry genuinely more fun. You are doing yourself a disservice if you don't choose him for as your recitation instructor. :)

Yoel is the absolute best!! I had him for both Chem I and Chem II and loved him! He is very passionate about chemistry and will be willing to help you whenever you need it! Overall, I highly recommend taking Yoel if you can
LOVE LOVE LOVE Yoel! Honestly the best recitation instructor every! Definetely take him if you have a chance

Yoel is honestly the best recitation instructor ever! He always sends us resources for studying for the midterms/finals, and always answers any questions you have (he literally responds to his emails in 2 minutes). Definitely choose him when you take gen chem!!!
Yoel regularly sends out emails with study tips and guides. He keeps you updated with course work and grades.

Yoel is the best thing to happen to General Chemistry. If you have a chance to take his recitation, DO SO! I've learned the most on Friday recitations, more so than in Lab or even in lecture. He really combines individual-learning, group-learning, and lecture-based learning. He's amazing and caring and will make sure you UNDERSTAND the material.

I felt that I got a true grasp of chemistry during his recitation and he truly had the best interest of his students in mind. If possible, I would 100% recommend that you enroll in his lab and recitation sections.

Yoel is honestly one of the best TA's you could ever have for Gen Chem! Try to get his recitation session--ask someone who had him last semester as he lets them know what sections he teaches. He's caring, funny, and honestly always there if you need someone to talk to. He made chem understandable and is such an easygoing guy. Definitely recommend!

Yoel is truly the best recitation instructor. He cares and makes learning fun and easy. You could talk to him about anything and he strays away from making class stressful. I would take him ten times over.

Yoel was a wonderful TA and genuinely cared about his students. He was always accessible and didn't take long to email back. I had him for recitation and he would go over important concepts that we needed to know for the exam. He is also a very funny and laid back guy. Take his class if you get the chance!

Professor Yoel was what made morning lab, interesting, fruitful, unique and enjoyable. He cares about his students, he wants what is best for them, and would go out of his way to make sure we understood what we are doing on a theoretical and practical level. His sense of humor, along with his mastery over teaching the subject is what made him GOAT.

Yoel was my favorite TA at NYU ever. He really cares about his students and his sense of humor and personality make chemistry fun. He is super accessible outside of class and always emails back within minutes, and his emails with study tips and chemistry info are really useful. If you have a chance to take any of his classes, I highly recommend it.

One of the most respected and well liked teachers out there. Incredibly easy to get along with. Always has great material ready for you in order to crush the exams, and has never failed to go out of his way to help me if need. Highly recommend!

Yoel was the best professor and TA ive had at NYU - he explained chemistry concepts extremely well and always made sure we were well prepared for the exams. His office hours were open on the weekends and made it extremely easy to excel if you put in the effort!

Yoel is the best! Do anything you can to take one of his classes. Best recitations, and so helpful in and outside of class. He cares so much about every student and is ALWAYS available if you have any questions.
Hes a great guy!

Honestly, you can't go through undergraduate and have a fulfilling college experience without taking a class with Yoel. A funny guy and relatable as hell. He will make chemistry a piece of cake and does everything to help you along the way. A definite must!!!!!!!

Yoel is definitely a TA you will never forget. He is super funny and cares for each of his students which is why he is constantly available for office hours. Literally, at any time he will answer your questions. Take him if you can!!! #FAM

Yoel is genuinely one of the best instructors I have had. He cares about teaching and making sure that we understand the material. He has an open door policy for asking questions, which really shows that he wants us to do well. I'd recommend Yoel to anyone planning to take General Chemistry.

Yoel really cares about all his students and he makes it so easy for students to meet with him. He has an open door every day for questions and you can tell he really wants you to succeed. He is extremely thorough, caring, and his averages for the midterms for his section are always higher than average (because he's a really good teacher)!

Yoel is a treasure to education. He genuinely cares about his students success and he is exceptionally knowledgeable. Beyond the class room he has a vested interest in his students career path. If you have the opportunity to take a class with him, do it. Simple as that!

Yoel is unquestionably the best professor at NYU. His dedication to the students' wellbeing, success, and breath of knowledge is unprecedented. His wit and intelligence makes chemistry fascinating and fun. He supports the students' efforts with supplementary questions. I looked forward to all of his labs and lectures. He brings chemistry to life!

Yoel truly cares about his students. He's quick with emails and has office hours to get extra help. I had him for two semesters and I was never disappointed. He's very approachable and will definitely help you with not only Chemistry, but life advice as well.

Yoel was honestly the reason I moved from a B in Gen Chem I to an A- in Gen Chem II. The course was challenging for me because my study habits weren't great, but he was so motivating, very very accessible for office hours and individualized tutoring, and always sent so many study materials. If you just put in some effort, he'll be there for you.
best teacher i've had so far at NYU. made me smile every lab!

I haven't had this professor in 4 years and yet every single time I think about college I think about his class, his genuine investment and concern, and his wealth of knowledge.I was blessed to have Yoel during chemistry, he had the best personality,methods of teaching,and ways of translating chemical equations into a language easier to understand.

Apart from being our hilarious, much-loved celebrity instructor, Yoel is incredibly generous in helping his students. He always made the class environment so enjoyable and I always looked forward to his classes. He allots A LOT of his time for office hours and he is very patient and clear when helping you out with difficult topics. THANKS YOEL!!
He does pull-ups in class!

Yoel is one of the best professors I have had at NYU. He really cares about the students. The subject matter is not easy, but he teaches and explains everything clearly. The notes he provides are clear and informational, and you will have a lot of fun learning the material. I highly recommend this class, take it, you will not regret it at all.

Any chance you have to take a class from Yoel, grab the opportunity. Outside of his obvious intelligence, he cares deeply for his students and does everything he can to ensure we all do well. He has office hours everyday but you can email him at anytime and he is always happy to meet with you. He has a great sense of humor! Loved him!
Chronological and very detailed notes. Very caring towards his students. Perfect balance of personal and professional communication. 10/10

Even though I took DNA nanotechnology as a required course, and the subject itself was hard, if you have any chance of taking a class with Yoel, you should take it. He's absolutely wonderful and can make any class worth taking. 10/10 would recommend and would definitely take again!

Yoel is a great teacher, very devoted all the while laid back and has a sense of humor. He makes chem understandable and enjoyable. He is very approachable and always makes time for his students. If you have the opportunity to take him for recitation/lab, don't pass it up!

College would be much better if there were more professors like Yoel. He is a wonderful teacher, always available for his students, always eager to help them. He really cares about students and their performance in the class. I wish I could take more classes with him.

Yoel is one of the best teachers out there. He truly cares about students and patiently will explain anything until the students understands. Anyone who has the chance the learn/do research under Yoel is lucky because you will have the opportunity to learn a lot about dna nanotech and do amazing research. Truly one of the best in the chem dept.

Yoel is an admirably patient and understanding professor. He is both a lover of life and science. No matter how many questions you ask him, he will always be available with a bright positive smile on his face. His knowledge of chemistry is inspiring and his passion for his students/work is genuinely praiseworthy.

Yoel is an extremely knowledgeable professor who can pretty much help you understand anything concerning  chemistry. Unlike most professors he is easy to talk to so communication is never really an issue. Definitely try to get Yoel as your professor if you can.
Yoel goes above and beyond to help his students. He's truly an amazing person and he's always willing to help 24/7. I don't think chemistry would be the same without him.
Yoel is the reason many students were able to pass chemistry and stay on the pre-med track. I can't say enough to express my gratitude toward him. NYU students are the luckiest to have him.
Very helpful and cares. Now I have chemistry with chemistry because of him. Miracle worker indeed.~~~

Yoel is amazing. I recommend him above anyone else. He truly cares about his students and is willing to go the extra mile to help them understand. Not only does he offer help during recitations, he also offers many study sessions daily for review. He cracks a few jokes here and there and overall makes learning chem easy and fin!

Yoel is the epitome of a great teacher and mentor. I was fortunate to have had the opportunity to work with him and the work ethic, enthusiasm, and drive that he displayed is something that will stick with me for a very long time. If you have the opportunity to be his student, jump at it; you won't regret it.
Yoel is great! and very helpful

He cares a lot about his students. If you take the time to go to his review sessions, I can guarantee you'll understand the class better. Definitely pick him as your TA for recitation and/or lab as he is very helpful, is a great motivator, and brings so much energy to the room.

Yoel may quite possibly be the most dedicated professor I have ever known. Besides his regular teaching duties, he holds numerous study sessions and review sessions at various times to make sure that everyone can always attend at least one. Sometimes I wonder if this man even sleeps bc he is ALWAYS available to help online as well. Simply the best

Yoel is the go to guy! He is always available to help his students, I've never came across such a dedicated professor. He knows what he is doing, he is very clear and helpful. He holds review sessions all the time and they are more helpful than the lectures. If you have the option choose Yoel don't hesitate !
Yoel is one of the most friendly and helpful professors I've had. He genuinely cares for his students and wants to see them succeed, both in and out of the classroom.

Yoel knows the material of the course extremely well and offers extra study sessions multiple times per week outside of lecture to help students understand the material. He explains concepts thoroughly and clearly and is always available for extra help. Also he's funny.

If you are in chemistry, you want Yoel as your T.A. He is super helpful and even holds outside review sessions to go over material if you need it. His classes are extremely helpful and he answers everybody's questions but he's also pretty funny and makes them interesting.

never met a TA that cared so much about his students. struggled in Halpin's class in the beginning of the year and Yoel helped me get on track to do better-- he wasn't even my TA! took him for Gen Chem II lab and he made things clear and fun. if you want to have a good Gen Chem experience, take Yoel. if not, umm good luck i guess?....

Yoel is a great professor. He is always more than willing to help every student, and goes far out of his way to make himself available for them. He is also very funny and has a good sense of humor which makes the class time very entertaining. I would definitely recommend being in his section! You won't regret it.

If you wish to do well, Yoel gives you enough resources to do so. Gives plenty of study sessions and stresses the point of practice makes perfect.  Read notes thoroughly to pass the course and when in doubt utilize the fact that Yoel answers a ton of questions and answers them well. Fair grader and very approachable.

Yoel is one of the rare gems you will be blessed to encounter during college. Always willing to help, Yoel invests his time and energy so that even one student can do better. Great sense of humor and down to earth, you become his friend!

Yoel is one of the few helpful TAs in NYU who not only helps students out grade wise but also does his best to help students understand the material and eventually master it. He offers review sessions that are super helpful and goes above and beyond to aid his current and even previous students.

Yoel is a man fully committed to his students. He will take time out of his schedule nearly every day to reach out and help students in any part of Gen Chem they need help on. The man also has a refreshing sense of humor which will lighten the atmosphere in a pretty serious setting with some pretty serious students. He was fantastic, top class.

Yoel is 100% invested in his students. He truly wants his students to understand and do well and organizes study sessions during his own free time (almost everyday including weekends). He is also hilarious and likes to troll a lot. Lax on HW, and explains the postlabs well. Chem is hard but he made it a little easier and more enjoyable!

yoel dedicates a lot of time in helping his students understand chemistry. he goes above and beyond what is required of him because he enjoys seeing his students succeed. on top of that, he makes learning funny. i think he used to be a professional clown, before becoming a chem professor, but that is just speculation. highly recommended!

Yoel is an intelligent and dedicated professor who truly cares about his students. He is able to convey intricate concepts with conciseness and simplicity. I have never met a professor who cares as much about the success of their students; he is always willing to make time to help. For that I am truly touched.  I highly recommend Yoel's courses.

Yoel is so so helpful and really nice. He makes himself available for students like pretty much every day and even holds study sessions on weekends. He is clearly very dedicated and wicked smart. Good for o-chem as well as g-chem!
Yoel's so awesome. I was able to enjoy chemistry because of him! He's helpful, funny, and nice. I highly recommend him.

His independent study course was interesting, fun, and helpful. Super nice, great at what he does, and made a difficult topic (DNA nanotechnology-- yeah, I was scared at first too) more accessible to students. Great course and professor.

I've never had a professor that was so willing to help his students or so committed to helping us learn. Without him I would have been totally lost. Great guy, amazing teacher, highly recommended. THANK YOU

Yoel is by far one of the best professors I have had at NYU. He cares about helping you learn and he is willing to go above and beyond to teach you the material. I also had Yoel as my TA for chem and orgo, and he was a huge part of why I was able to do well.

I HIGHLY recommend Yoel’s Indp Study class. I’ll always appreciate Yoel for sharing his knowledge & enthusiasm of DNA nanotech.  Yoel is extremely approachable & his passion for chemistry is highly contagious. He even volunteered teaching DNA nanotech lectures over the summer! I will forever respect Yoel as one of the greatest professors at NYU! :)

Yoel is one of the best people/ professors out there. He genuinely cares about his students and does his absolute best to help them suceed. Hes easy to talk with and is always wiling to donate his time for extra review sessions. Hes fantastic!
Yoel is the best professor ive ever had throughout undergraduate and graduate level classes. The most personable, knowledgable professor out there!
Awesome!

Yoel is a very committed professor to his students. If you are having trouble with a concept or classwork he will take time out of his day to help you. I felt Yoel had a thorough knowledge of Chemistry. In addition Yoel is very sociable and easygoing. I would highly recommend Yoel as he is one of the most competent instructors I have encountered.
Yoel is awesome! He brought a sense of calm to what is normally a pre-med's nightmare. He also knows the material inside-out. 10/10 experience.

Is highly involved in his field and does his best to keep students involved. He regularly sends out supplementary materials based on current research in his field. In fact, many students create customized "Yoel" folders for the great volume of materials he sends over email.

Speaking as a student that has now completed all the pre-medical courses, Yoel is without a doubt the best teacher I've had. He spent all his extra hours giving review sessions, but more importantly, took away the anxiety of getting a "good grade" and put the focus on teaching! He truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Amazing!

Yoel is one of the most (if not the most) dedicated professors in the science department. It is not by chance that Yoel's students always perform the best on the tests. He takes the time to make sure his students understand the material and he volunteers his personal time to make sure his students dont fall behind. He is an AWESOME professor!!

I am sooo happy I took Yoel's class! He was always around to help and made my semester really easy and fun. I never thought I would be interested in DNA nanotechnology but I really learned a lot. I found that it was actually really interesting too! I recommend this to anyone!!
