Steppy (as she playfully known by her students ) is one of the most caring and knowledgeable teachers at NYU--a rare mix in core class professors. I had Professor Stepp in Hunter College and she is an amazing math professor. She is very genuine and intelligent in her field. I would really like her again and again if I could!!

She seems strict at first, but she really isn't. She's very nice and is very clear when teaching the class. Amazing math professor that is always willing to go above and beyond especially in terms of helping. She does assign a lot of home work but it is to keep the material fresh in the students minds. THE BEST MATH PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD

Elizabeth keeps her students laughing from the beginning to the end of class! She is such a character and a great character. She offers extra help if needed and the class is not too bad even for those not skilled in math. Take her class for CORE!!

I hate hate hate math, and was required to take at least one math course. I would highly recommend Prof. Stepp, especially her Great Ideas in Mathematics course. She made math actually interesting and accessible.

She's just the best. I hate math and she's made it at least tolerable for me.

good professor

He's amazing! very passionate about teaching and helping the students!

He made finance interesting & easy to learn. Definitely take his class!

Professor Benaroya was my favourite professor during my first semester at NYU. I was new to finance and totally clueless - Professor made it so easy for all of us to understand complex concepts. The best part of the class is the projects as they help you apply the concepts you learn. No textbooks, easy quizzes is the best part of the class!

Benaroya is a rare find when it comes to professors. From his lectures, assignments, and tests, the class is meant to be stress-free and he works with you to help you succeed. When you enter his classroom, you are going to learn how finance is applicable to a career in marketing (not just a bunch of technical terms). His class is a MUST at NYUSPS.

Wonderful professor. He genuinely cares about teaching his students and having them engaged during class. He teaches from personal experience, and he sure does have a lot of it. The group project during the semester is interesting and the guest speakers he brings adds an extra level to the course.

Professor George Benaroya is not teaching based on just some book. His lectures are based on real life cases and concrete financial reports of existing public companies. In my opinion that's the best approach when you want to learn to apply the knowledge. I wish every class would be so useful.
Such an incredible professor. His lectures were very interesting and inspiring. Definitely sign up for his class if you have the opportunity!

George is a real gurus on finances. Great resume, experiences and knowledge make his class useful in real world. He also takes great care to his students. In my startup company, he offers great help and resources. True inspirational, noble and treasurable choice.
I really love the professor!

Benaroya is one of the very few instructors Ive come across in my educational career who truly goes above and beyond for his students. He really knows how to challenge a student and help them reach their best potential, even if that requires extra time outside of the classroom. Would recommend him 110%!!

Professor George Benaroya is one of the best professors I have met. His lecture is beneficial in real-world business and easy to understand. The homework is helpful to understand the lecture and practical. He likes his students, and he is willing to help students too. I strongly recommend taking Professor George Benaroya's classes.

He is the best professor I have ever met, very professional and responsible. He help me with some problem I dont get and offer me extra meeting to solve my problems and he really encouraged me to study and build confidence to me.

Professor Benaroya is everything you can ask when registering for a class. Worked so much but learned even more. Its the most rewarding class I have ever taken in my life. I highly recommend and make sure to take advantage of the best professor for Finance. He makes finance FUN.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR
if this class is taken by ANYONE ELSE then u should take it otherwise AVOID AVOID AVOID. 
She gave us a midterm right before spring break and then IN THE MIDDLE OF SPRING BREAK decided she was going to make us do ANOTHER on THE DAY WE GET BACK. LIKE THAT MONDAY. and it was going to be 64 questions. THIS WAS HORRENDOUS.

Attendance not exactly mandatory, but sometimes there were quizzes (although they were on brightspace so you could just do them from anywhere). super easy, you don't really even have to do the readings to do well. exams are all MC

Good subject, too much work for a Cultures & Contexts class. Like, truly an unreasonable amount of projects (a 45 minute podcast is ridiculous, on top of a final exam, research paper, and presentation). If you have a life/difficult major/or want any free time, do not take.

reviews.comment: Ben Shitrit's Modern Israel class was very interesting. She seemed to care a lot about the students and making sure they understood the conflict. However, there was a lot of reading which was difficult to understand. Her guest lecturers were very interesting.

reviews.comment: The professor is very caring and kind to students. She is also good at teaching, and lectures were focused and useful - so take notes. Class has many long readings which will be important for project and exams, though exams were easy, online, and all multiple choice when I had her. She grades leniently as well. Overall a really kind professor!
Take her! Amazing Lectures, really subject-focused and interesting reading for this course. Also accessible and kind outside of class. Not too much stress as other Culture and Contexts course does.

Professor Ben Shitrit gave incredibly interesting lectures, and I actually wanted to pay attention all of the time. The readings that were assigned were never a waste of time, as they sometimes are in other classes, and genuinely helped me become more educated on both course materials and worldly knowledge.

He has extensive experience in arts marketing and is highly passionate about his work. Be ready to participate in class, and he grades kindly. His lectures are very engaging, and he truly cares about ensuring his students understand the material. I definitely recommend!

Absolutely my favorite class/prof so far. As someone hoping to pursue a future in arts marking, I cant think of someone I'd want to learn from more than Jed. He has a fantastic knowledge of niche areas of the arts, and presents everything in a really clear and coherent way. He's also super fun and caring, and brings snacks often (!!!!!!)

I adore this man. My favorite professor so far in college. He taught me so much. His lectures are informative and he encourages participation. 2 essays and a final project. I met with him outside of class for career advice and he was helpful. He brings in industry professionals as guest lecturers.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall nice professor; very understanding and easy to work with. Assignments: 2 essays, 1 group project. I would say participation and attentiveness is a large part of the grade as well. Very easy grader.
Never absent from any class, speak up half of the class, but received 50% of grades in participation.

The professor is very educated about theatre. But for me and many others who thought the class would be more art oriented, this is not a good class to take. In addition, the professor grades overly harsh on participation and attendance. Miss two classes? 67% on participation and attendance.

the GREATEST human being/professor to exist at NYU. he really cares about his students and goes above and beyond to show it (brings pizza/snacks to class and actually listens to us for feedback). i could go on and on about jed so if you have the chance TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!

- The instructions and classes are extremely unorganized so as all the deadlines and gradings - feedbacks are vague and honestly writing center might be more helpful than that

- Not very accessible after class, very slow on email responses (sometimes may lose track on what you said before in the email)

reviews.comment: She is nice and friendly. If you consider her classes, remember to manage your time well. REALLY IMPORTANT!!!

Dr. Bernhardt was always there to answer questions and support everybody in the class. Be ready to work hard, do the work / show you care, and you'll do great.

Great professor! I don't understand why someone gave her low score. I am not a good English speaker but I have really learned a lot about writing by working hard. By devoting efforts to your tasks, you can easily get A.
Worst professor at Tandon. Do not take her.

She is such a wonderful professor at Tandon!! If you need to choose one expos course, just take her! Her lecture is so interesting and the workload is not very heavy compared to other professor. Very good professor. She is willing to give help and doesn't count attendance. Easy A if you take this course seriously. Her feedback is useful when you revise your essay, and she is not that tough as other people saying.

RUN! For those who still want to pick her again in the second semester, get urself a phycologist. She is always yagging, fake smiling, won't shut up even when you are working on the tasks she assigned in class. TBH, she should go to a doctor for her ADHD. 
You feel extremely stressful during class.

The professor is highly unprofessional. She's so stressed out all the time; she ends up making it everyone's problem. run as far as you can. catastrophic!!!!!

reviews.comment: Firstly, this is not a personal opinion, I am speaking for my whole class: DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. She cared about her ability to keep her job so she would pretend that she was helping you but she did not care about her students whatsoever. She offered office hours but they were useless along with her irrelevant feedback. I repeat, DO NOT CHOOSE HER

You'll hate her when taking her class, but really miss her after you try another writing class. She really cares about your writing. Yes she is a tough grader, but she really pushes you to your limit and you'll realize you can actually learn so much. Take her if you wanna learn and challenge yourself. Btw I got an A from her. It's possible.

Prof. Bernhardt is an extremely tough grader and could be slightly ambiguous, especially when it comes to feedback. I wouldn't take the class again but I feel that my writing has significantly improved after taking her class. I got a B and it was one of the highest grades in the class...

She's not going to coddle you, and will tell you when you can do better. Tough grader, but only because she wants you to improve. Learned a lot from her. A lot of work, but worth it for what you learn from it.

She doesn't give clear feedback. Her class was impossible to get a good grade in and you rarely get positive feedback so you do not know if you are improving. After revising an essay with multiple instructors and peers, and making all the changes she suggested, the essay still got a B grade. Even the students she loved did not get A's.
She is a very good professor who is alway enthusiastic about helping you with your essays. WTE sucks, but shes a good professor, dont confuse the two

the class is still okay if you try really hard, but such efforts are not very fair compared to other writing teachers who are much less demanding. An essay she gives B to will definitely get like a A- in other classes. She is one HARD grader, first essay ranged from D+ to a B+, not one A- exists in both her classes!!

i had her for writing the essay in my first semester of freshmen year. this class made my first semester a horror and brought down my self esteem so much. she made me feel really horrible about my writing and never attempted to really help but criticize. worst. teacher. ever.

She really needs to do some self-introspection. The class is more about philosophy rather than improving students writing skills. She plays big time favorites. Is useless and unhelpful both at the same time. Avoid at all cost.

She literally kicked me out of the class. The assignments are just nonsense and even though you put a lot of effort in them, she is never satisfied and better yet she never tells you how to fix your mistakes or improve your  writing. That's why only her sections are left open through the end of registration.

She will tell you that everything you do is wrong but won't say how to fix it. The course is not making me better, it's making me more confused. I've never felt so helpless with a class. She will tell you tell you one thing one day and then tell you it's wrong the next. SHE MAKES ME HATE MY LIFE!

One of the worst teachers you can have for Writing the Essay. I wish I switched out of her class a lot earlier. All her comments are negative, but she does not tell you what to fix in your essay. Does not give out good grades easily and gets very irritated if you are late. Do not miss her class more than twice.
I went to her at the writing center twice, the second time on accident. She is the single most unhelpful person at the writing center!!!!! Love the writer center though..
Kim is nice, but she does play favorites.  She has very high standards, so be prepared.

She makes WTE such a big deal, which it is not. She also expects too much, and wants things done in a very certain way. When reviewing your work, she criticizes everything, but doesn't tell you why or how to fix it.

she is THE. ABSOLUTE. WORST. if you have her, run away, back out, switch profs.  She is unhelpful, irritable, rude, close-minded, and wastes your time at one-on-ones after youve walk all the way to the writing center in guam. doesnt listen to students, contradicts herself, puts too much emphasis on WTE. grades/comments are ridiculous in every way.

I went from extremely aggravated at the beginning of the year to neutral by the end. Maybe it's because I got a good grade that I was able to tolerate writing the essay, which is going to be a pain no matter which teacher you get.

She doesn't do much to enrich your understanding of the texts you look at in class; conferences with her have a 50-50 shot of being useful.  She clearly plays favorites in her class.  The are much better WTE teachers out there; Kimmy shouldn't be at the top of your list.
Hard but you'll learn a lot in the end.
horrible, horrible experience. do not, i repeat, do not do it.

Close-minded professor.  Gave her opinion on my life choices in a personal essay.  Don't be 30 seconds late or she counts it as absent.  Unless you are her favorite, then you can come in 15 minutes late.  Talks very fast, unfriendly, unclear.  Don't do it.

I find it amazing that the "University of the Other" has hired an instructor who tells her students that they are wrong for having their own thought process.  She is simply frustruating, if you're taking Writing the Essay, find another instructor!
Thinks her subject is the Lord of all subjects and gets irritated wayyy too easily.  Could use a chill pill.  Doesn't explain things clearly either.
She constantly says one thing on one day, and another thing on another day.

Kimberly is certainly affable and can be genuinely interesting at times. The structure of the course makes it difficult to discern your progress, but I'm not sure that she was much help either. There are better WTE classes than this so look around.
She was so confusing and unhelpful.  dont take writing the essay with her!

I really liked his teachings, provides helpful videos prior to exams to help study really wants his students to learn the subject. Attendance not mandatory but I think going in and taking the EC quizzes were what saved me.

Very laid back, prof. Attendance is not mandatory at all. He teaches alright but sometimes makes a few mistakes here and there. He's quite forgiving on his exams as he gives big curves. 

The good thing is that he does an online review before each exam, with tons of practice questions that do help.
He is a good professor overall, however, he can sometimes be unclear with his instructions.
Great instructor. Concise lectures, easy to follow and understand. One of the best professors I've had!
Good person.

Take her for hindi class if you can. She is hilarious and so funny. I would only recommend if you have some knowledge of hindi or speak another language similar to it. Grade is dependent on trying to actually learn the language rather than perfection.

truly one of the best professors at nyu. she is so caring and truly wants everyone to learn. she is so funny but this class is not for true beginners. i would advise against the class if you cant speak even a little or even understand the language.
Professor Bhargava cares more about you learning the language than grading you harshly on small assignments. The class is very centered around participation so you need to attend all sessions.

Prof truly cares about our learning and making sure we can apply material to real life. But Elementary is def not for pure beginners. Luckily I have a little background in Hindi but if you don't know an ounce of it, I wouldn't recc. This class is purely participation and group work, with lots of small assignments.
Auntieji is amazing and I love her. She's a great professor. Very nice. Explains things well. She doesn't believe in tests, so she actually just cares that you learn.

I always looked forward to his class and it amazes me how he is fitted up every day. Pretty reasonable grader, and the readings, while long, I thought were more interesting than the ones I've had to read for other LS classes. So knowledgable but doesn't shove it in your face and really likes to hear what we have to say. Take him!!

Professor Bhatt is a gem in the LS department! He cares a lot about student's opinions, but also gives good information making sure you can be prepared for the midterm/final if you pay attention. The midterm is an exam taken in class, but the final is a take home exam. The class is very discussion-based, but he's open to new ideas! TAKE HIM!!
Easiest professor ever! And he's funny. TAKE HIM

Great professor all around, sees both sides of the argument, midterm is MC and short answers, and then the final is a taken essay. Great person and thinks very highly of his student opinions. Also he gives out free candy.

Professor Bhatt is the best! Easily the best Global Works professor I have had, and maybe even one of the best at NYU. He is highly knowledgeable, passionate, and caring for his students. The class is 75% discussion, so it is crucial to participate. If you have the chance, TAKE HIM!
I love him!! LITERALLY the BEST Global Works professor in all of the LS department. MY GOAT!!!!!!
This guy is the easiest and best professor, you will learn and enjoy. Best I've ever had at NYU.

Vivek is a wonderful professor who truly has a passion for both the course topics as well as a desire for students to engage in meaningful conversations surrounding course topics. If you are interested in the course themes, then this discussion-heavy class is right for you! He also offers support on writing papers and processing your ideas.

This guy is the best, truly my favourite Professor. what a g, knows his stuff and isn't a tough grader. feel free to speak up when you can, just here or there to let him know you're there. could not recommend more.

He is such a great professor. He values listening to his students' opinions, and each class session is very engaging on the respective topic he teaches. His class is interesting and some of the readings can be long, but you can skim them. TAKE HIM!

Prof. Bhatt is extremely insightful and love to hear your opinion about anything and everything. He is very laid back and understanding. There is a solid amount of reading, but it's not anything crazy. If you can take his class, DO IT. One of the best profs I've had.

Moreover she unnecessarily tries to implement so many technical stuff that just distract us from the actual content and end up wasting time.

reviews.comment: As somebody who had no prior experience working with matrices before this class, I can tell you that there's going to be a steep learning curve at the beginning. Get over that and develop a strong foundation on the basics to understand the material that's to come. Gets easier after subspaces imo but more DENSE. You better study. Async's are UGH.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Yea, I can't recommend her as her explanations / lessons are just needlessly overcomplicated. If you have a solid grasp of math in general, you'll probably be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's, a nice person, but she just re-iterates the book. Lectures are boring and not really engaging.. Content is hard, but not really her fault. You really need to work for a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Save yourself the trouble and just don't.

Prof. Bhat is extremely dedicated to her students. Despite discrete mathematics being tough in terms of content, since she makes herself available during office hours, her students can understand the content with work. She always hears out her students when they're having trouble and adjusts the workload accordingly. Do the work; you'll be fine :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Bhat is a very kind professor who genuinely wants her students to succeed. She does her best to help and explain difficult concepts to students. Office hours is a great time even if you don't have any questions. She is extremely accommodating and kind. 10/10 would recommend.

Prof. Bhat makes a new and difficult topic very manageable. Her lecture's have been much more engaging than other online classes. You definitely have to work, but her assignments really help you learn. Go to office hours! She is extremely willing to help you learn and is overall a wonderful person.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bhat's class is definitely hard, but that's just because discrete math is hard. She cares about her students, listens to their feedback, and adjusts her work load accordingly. She also allows you to drop a good amount of grades so that's nice. If you want to succeed in this class, going to office hours will make that really easy.
She just reads off of slides the whole time and drones. Classes are always incredibly long and dull and then she assigns us a bunch of busywork assignments.

The amount of homework we had at the start of the semester was rough, but she was willing to change based off of our feedback which was pretty nice of her. Grades were also heavily curved because a lot of students did not do too well.

She seems like a nice person but definitely does not understand linear algebra. It's a beautiful subject but had to rely on MIT's OpenCourseware to understand. Prof. Bhat cannot answer conceptual questions, makes many mistakes even when copying from the sheet she has, and lectures are basically her writing notes down and then reading them back.

The way Professor Bhat structures Linear Algebra online is typically one weekly quiz, one recitation worksheet, one problem set and one asynchronous assessment. Lots of work. Nice Professor. Exams do not match problem sets very well. Quizzes rely on "tricks" where HW is computational HEAVY
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Does not enhance/clarify your knowledge of LinAlg, making a student who isn't comfortable with the subject even more confused. Teaching style is memorization-based: begins with definition slides, and then jumps straight into computations. Poor pacing + unfair expectations for exams with regards to time and format. Nice person, but not a great prof.

Coursework is weird, personal reflection makes no sense. Classes always run late for 1015 mins. Expect us to follow instructions in emails that *she didn't mention in class* and give unreasonable harsh penalties. My inclass participation was ignored. Appear to be nice, but I do not understand why is it so hard to communicate with her individually
never take her course. Make this course the hardest thing ever. Have homework everyday, the window is very short, it will make a heart attack. The problem set extremely difficult.
Do not take her class!!! She only repeats the textbooks in a more confusing and difficult way. Her midterms and final are extremely difficult! Her class is just a waste of time.

Professor doesn't really seem to know what she is talking about. Reads directly off slides and doesn't do much explanation of anything. Lecture doesn't add anything to just reading the book and the questions you have won't be answered well. Daily quizzes aren't very hard, though. Homeworks aren't graded roughly, but that may just have been my TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Tough class and tends to just copy the textbook in her slides, but she's really nice + cares for her students and is always open to questions. There's a quiz everyday in class so make sure you go for that. STUDY THE TEXTBOOK bc a lot of hw/test questions are from there. Tests tends to be harder than classwork and homework.
She is great. The lecture is easy to understand, and she will send all the class materials to students which makes the reviw and pre-study easy.

Vindya is the best teacher ever. Yes we have mini quizzes at the beginning of every class and homework due often. But she's totally understanding if you need more time or help. She responds to emails all the time and is so caring. She also will explain things a bunch of different ways until you understand it. Take her for calc 2, you won't regret!

prof bhat is amazing. she is so organized and moves at a slow but engaging pace. she is not condescending at all and is really willing to help outside of class. I really believe she is invested in our individual success. I've never written a review before but i love vindya. obviously the content of calc 2 is difficult, but she makes it much easier!

She is very good at helping you understand. She has "class starters" (basically quizzes) which I thought I would hate but it actually helped me so much. I knew what I understood and it really helped me prepare for what the tests were going to be like.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She was super condescending and clearly does not know the material well. Classes were unecessarily stressful because of daily quizzes that take up 15% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took her for discrete math. She did not know the material well and often read off of slides. Tests were long and difficult. Overall grading was harsh. While she is organized, there are definitely other professors who will teach you the material better and more understanding on grading.
Made the class incredibly hard compared to previous semesters. Do NOT take!

Read off lecture sheets and did not explain concepts well. Condensed material of two midterms into one and rushed new material before exam. Office hours don't help either. Quizzes every class so it is easy to fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the best professors in Courant Math. However, homework sometimes requires a lot of work and include some of the unnecessary questions that will cost you nearly a full five hours to solve.

GO to lectures or you will struggle. Do the extra practice and read the textbook and do the practice problems even though it isn't mandatory. Sometimes her explanations are a little vague but keep pressing her to explain better and she will. She is very helpful in office hours. She's very knowledgeable and knows her stuff and presents it well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Bhat uploads all her lecture notes online, so studying is always easy. She's very accessible outside of class. Participation counts and there's also a short and easy "class starter" quiz every day.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Bhat is very caring, inspirational, humorous and willing to help. The lectures are clear. Highly recommend her class!

Professor Bhat is very organized, clear and very helpful. Sometimes she spends a little too much time organizing things or trying to be very, very clear in her notes, but that's not necessarily a bad thing. She posts all of the exercises online, which is great, and she's very willing to help you. Put in the work if you want to do really well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Put in the work  Do well. Always ready to help. She cares.
Professor Bhat goes slow in class and gives a lot of examples. Also really willing to help during office hours and emails. Clear guidance and instructions.

Professor Bhat gives so much work for how little you learn. She tries her best at lectures but most people zone out. Be prepared to learn a lot of the material on your own from the book. She's very helpful one-on-one, but don't expect to learn much during lecture. Also you better know how to code R if you want to have an easy go of homework.
shes alright. trails off during midsentence

Vindya Bhat is mad lit. She recommended this movie about math for a bunch of us to watch, it seemed lame so no one went but the gesture was cool. Just show up to class and do your homework, you're the one dropping 60K on the degree. Her tests are hard but at the end of the day calc is the art of surfing the curve.

Professor Bhat is probably one of the best Calc 1 professors at NYU. She's really, REALLY organized. I especially liked how she structures her lectures. She uploads lecture slides in advance so we know exactly what will be covered in class, and she runs through a few examples to explain theories. Excellent professor, would definitely recommend.
Such a great professor. Weekly Quiz hw and web assign are required. 20 Attendances are recorded.  Love her so I take her statistics next semester. Clear speech. Appropriate pace.

I am in Calc 1. She gives clear explanations in class. Do your webassigns for practice. It's great and it really helps. Don't cheat on them. Her tests are hard if you don't study diligently. She is always happy to ask and her explanations are through but you have to ask her for help.
Homework was super hard and long every week; weekly quizzes that were pretty easy. Midterms are HARD. My average wo counting exams was a 95%, w them it drops to an 80%.
she's always willing to help, but her homework is so difficult and so time consuming. It's ridiculous.
Clear in explanation. If you are confused, simply ask, either in class or at some other time.
He is the best professor in the world, I can't express how much I love him!!! He made my day whenever i had his lectures. BEST PROFESSOR EVERRRRRRRRRRRRR!!!!!!!!!

He is extremely clear about his expectations and grades very fairly. If you study for the quizzes and show up to them, you will do well in the class. It is extremely easy to get an A in this class if you just put in the work.
Self learnt everything. Don't take him.
Completely blindsided by my grade. Do not take him!
Lots of quizzes but easy if you just do a quizlet. Clear grading criteria. Great professor very old school. as long as you put in a little effort you'll be fine.

This class was great and easy to get an A if you just do what you're expected to - go to class, study for tests/exams, prepare thoroughly. For those of you getting Bs and below, you are just not trying hard enough. This class isn't hard.

Honestly, this class is hella easy. As long as you actually do the readings and study for the quizzes you'll get an A. Also his lectures are very insightful and fun, especially if you actually like hospitality. The only downside is the quizzes and the final are your entire grade. So if you don't do well on them, drop the class.

He doesn't give a damn f about your grade. No opportunities for improvement. Do not even try! Tests 35% of the grade and are every week, final exam 40%. If you are 2 minutes late you receive a 0. Impossible to change it! Prepare for final exam 2 weeks in advance or you will fail! Around 300 terms and questions to memorize, no multiple choice.
He's great and insightful. Catch is, he's strictly by the syllabus and quizzes every single week. If you pay attention, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory because there is a quiz in every single class. None of the course materials or homework are posted on Brightspace. He does not post any grades throughout the semester. The only grade you see is the final grade on Albert. He doesn't provide feedback on the final exam or explain the components that make up your overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be ready to have only quizzes every week and then the final. No other methods to earn points for ur final grade. He never explained why you get the grade you get for the final or ur final grade. The class lectures are very boring as well.

This professor is extremely challenging. He doesn't post materials online, has zero tolerance for late work, and contradicts the textbook. If you're even slightly late, you can't take the quiz. Review sheets barely align with quizzes, making it hard to study. In all my years, I've never struggled with a professor like this.
He always forgets who have done or haven't done the homework and randomly gives you a zero. It's impossible to argue for your grades even though it's his problem.
SB
His lecture is totally different from final exams. Don't expect to get a normal grade in this course.

I loved Dr. Bjorn Hanson's class so much! 100% recommended. So people commented that they couldn't hear his voice, but I would say what about sitting in the front? lol. But seriously, he is a respected industry professional, a lot of good guest speakers and industry comments in the classroom.

One of my favorite professors of all time. Super caring, passionate, and informative. Definitely take his class if you get the chance to. Make sure to show up each week because there are weekly vocabulary quizzes. Exam was straightforward and not too hard, only took me about 20 minutes to finish.

Knowledgeable about the industry, but oftentimes contradicts textbook information. Weekly quizzes are somewhat annoying, but helps you retain content better. Sometimes gives vague instructions and is definitely more of an 'industry professional' than a university professor. Forget everything, Dr. Hanson is always right.

Lectures were super long and sometimes uninteresting. We didn't have much homework but expect weekly quizzes. Professor Hanson is very well respected in the industry and it was cool to hear about this experience in the industry.

The professor usually made self-mistakes. If you want to take his class, please keep every record of your homework if you have done.
Or he will forgets you have done this homework and gives you a zero.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He gave us quizzes for every class covering vocabs and the content from previous classes. Even though he incorporated group discussions and presentations, most of his lectures were on his experiences in the hospitality industry. The expectations on both midterm and final exams were difficult, and most of the questions were short-answer/long-answer.

Professor Hanson was so clear and passionate about what he was teaching 100% of the time. There are weekly quizzes on chapters from the textbook but Professor Hanson always goes over the chapters in depth and as long as you read the chapter and studied for a little bit, you'll do great. The lectures can be long but very interesting.

Professor Hanson is an overall great and easy teacher. His expectations are clear and he can be lenient (just talk to him!) I am so thankful he was teaching this course. Very well respected and known by SPS and in the hospitality community. Lectures can be quite long and a bit boring, but he has his own fun stories to add. Loved it!
A really great professor with awesome stories. There are quizzes every week but as long as you study you'll be fine. Seriously such a nice guy. 10/10 reccomend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Hanson is awesome. He knows very well about the concept and he really wants to see everyone's progress. A lot of participation chances, and he respects everyone's ideas. Take his class if you have the chance.

Professor Hanson is extremely well known within the Hospitality industry. If you have the privilege of being taught by him definitely take advantage of it. He's so sweet and always dresses nice for class. He is also very funny and tells tons of stories about his past experiences in the industry. Absolutely loved his class!
The professor is super chill and nice. Not there to fail anyone. Has really good experience in the industry to make connections with. Take his class
Awful. Quizzes and final exams were extremely difficult. Spent the majority of class time telling stories of his glory days at PwC than actual teaching. Glad he finally left NYU.
Bjorn is just a cool guy and he honestly isn't here to fail anyone. I've had him twice and I have liked his classes both times.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Hanson is one of the best professors of the department. He is very experienced and always includes insightful anecdotes/stories at his lectures. You will have short quizzes almost every week but it will help you prepare for the final and you will learn a lot about hospitality.  His grading is very straightforward.

His lectures and stories were engaging. NYU is so lucky to have such a remarkable person. Quizzes and final were fair - straight from the textbook and lectures. Hanson even provides a handy review guide for quizzes to guide our studying in the right path. If you pay attention to the lectures and read the book, you will do very well in this course.

Dr. Hanson is an amazing professor, has great lectures, but is a very, very tough grader. Though he is a respected industry professional, he seems to be a bit arrogant about it at times. Would not recommend taking his class simply because he is an extremely strict grader. Quizzes are very short and VERY specific. (As is the final).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He words everything completely different than the textbooks or lectures on quizzes. so confusing.
Professor Hanson is a respected industry figure. His lectures are helpful with many of his industry stories.

His lectures have fun stories of his experience in the hospitality industry. Not much homework, but a quiz almost every week. Quizzes aren't hard as long as you read the textbook. His study guides are VERY helpful. Overall, a really great professor. He's very friendly, approachable, and understanding.

Quiz almost every single week. (about 8-10). Expect to learn 30-80 vocab words a chapter, with about 8-15 question quiz. No MC, only fill ins! READ TEXTBOOK FOR QUIZZES. He's so nice, just extremely strict on time. If you are a commuter student, it wont matter if your train derails into the ocean, you're still expected to show up on time.

Very knowledgeable about the industry and explains the material clearly. He used to be the dean and he cares about the student a lot. Very professional and kinda have a plainmonotone personality, but he will be there to help you.
Great teacher! Always willing to help.  Prepares you for the real world through placing you in industry mind-sets.  Great man!
Nice guy, strict but only to prepare you for the real world. He's very nice and helpful if you are respectful and eager to learn

I've attended a few schools during my undergraduate career, and Professor Bjorke truly stands out as one of my favorite teachers. What sets him apart is his genuine kindness. His passion for Economics shines through in his lectures, which have opened my eyes to what the discipline is really about. He genuinely cares for his students.

Isaac is a fantastic professor, who teaches very well and with clarity. Yes, his class was very difficult, but that is due to having hard material. He does the best with what he is given, and is clearly a brilliant person, who cares about his students. Highly recommended, and would take again in a heartbeat.

Well, he is nice for reaching out outside of class. BUT the main thing is that HE GAVE THE MIDDLE AND FINAL ON A SUPER HARD LEVEL. His homework and sample exam are fine, at least for the one who just finish listing to his lecture, but his EXAM IS SUPER HARD. He really enjoy the feeling of making his students BREAKING UP DURING MIDTERM AND FINALS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly the best TA ive ever had. Super helpful and clear in his explanations and always available to help out. A lot of people think recitations are useless but for me this class with Isaac was 10x more helpful than any of the lectures. Grades the homework pretty leniently but gives good feedback. 10/10, definitely take him if u can

Had him for IO over the summer and he was not only amazing at reiterating information taught at class/helping with the problem sets but he also was always available on email and for office hours! Pretty generous grading if he sees you put in effort and values questions!

Professor Bjorke was pretty fast in lecture, but I honestly really learned in this class. Tests were hard but just like practice problems, so if you really studied you should have done well. I didn't know anything about probability before this class and now I feel pretty comfortable with a lot of probability problems. His notes were a bit messy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Summer 2021. He sometimes goes way too fast during lecture, maybe assuming that most of the class had at least taken high school stats before. Handwritten notes in most cases are not helpful and you have to re-watch lecture recordings to refresh. Exams are okay, which is similar to HW. HW is lenient, as long as you do it, it's full credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Everything about this class and professor is pretty standard. He didn't make things extra hard, nor did he make them any easier. His teaching was disorganized at times, but only slightly. If math isn't your thing, it could be harder, but overall, Isaac is a decent choice.

I tried very hard in this class and still struggled on the exams, which he told me not to fret. By the end of the course I felt that I did in fact understand the material really well, and it turned out that the curve helped me out alot. Great teacher.

Not college level teaching. Acting for kindergarten. We have to learn dialogue from scene study but she just says good job and because she is not an actress it is a waste of time. Other teacher section much better use of student energy.

I am so angry to find out now that Mary Bitel is away this semester because she is a terrible teacher first of all, she is not a professional actress and I could take this class this semester with a real actor!!!!!! She is a waste of time. She wants every person to like her that is all she cares about.

As someone who didn't know that much about acting Shakespeare, Mary was INCREDIBLY helpful! She was such a bright and positive force in the classroom, gave great feedback, and challenged my acting skills. Most importantly, she made sure everyone was having fun at the end of the day. HIGHLY recommend taking The Bard Out Loud with her!
She is so kind, and the Bard out Loud class was really fun. Gives great feedback, and as someone who has never done theater, she made it very easy and accessible. Take her!

I really liked Mary and her Working with Groups class. The class was interesting and taught me quite a bit that I plan to apply in the future. There's a lot of reading in order to really do well, and sometimes she's not always clear in her lectures. But, she's very accessible to meet with you outside of class if you need more personal help.

Mary is nice, but her Working with Groups class is so freaking boring. It seems like she says the same main points every class. The final paper is broken into three parts, and due over the course of the semester. There's no way to tell what your grade will be until the end of the semester. She's always willing to help, but the class is boring.
bro, safe urself. like actually save ur life. don't. jus don't
The course itself isn't that bad but the professor itself isn't the best.very inconsiderate at times if you are a minute late and doesn't take any excuses.

If you are struggling in this class I would personally not recommend going to her office hours for improvement. Since if you go to her office hours she would just insult you on how bad you did and say you should not majoring in econ. I would just personally recommend to go the Ta's office hours for help. Other than that she is fine.

By far the best class I've taken at NYU. If you're an Econ major leaning towards finance, this class is for you. I've had interview questions often asked about material that's taught in this class. Professor is strict for sure but everything will go smoothly if you follow her guidelines. (attend lecture she often will tell you whats on the exam!)
Tests can be confusing, not that hard though. No quizzes or anything else. Just tests. Pretty easy if you actually study to be honest.

Professor is extremely rude for little to no reason and despite what people say "you get what you give", it is practically impossible to get anything from this professor. Went for feedback on a test and she was extremely rude with no constructive criticism despite actively wanting to learn and improve.

She is definitely strict, but her rules are very clear: don't be late and don't go on your phone. As long as you follow those relatively simple requests, you'll be fine. Don't let all these ratings scare you. Her class is not as difficult as everyone says just read the textbook and study hard. There is a good curve at the end of the course.

Strict, but will be easier towards the end of the semester. Lectures are not needed if you just read the textbook, but will be helpful for graph drawing. Attend recitations. For studying, practice recitation problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is good and explains concepts clearly. If you attend class, take notes, and work hard, you will do well on the exams, since she literally tells you what will be tested. She can be a bit harsh at times, but the class itself is interesting and well-structured. As long as you put in the effort, you'll be fine. The material is manageable.

she's a good professor and funny, the class is just hard and she's pretty strict about certain things like using your phone or coming in late (sometimes she's rude to people who ask questions). Go to class, take good notes, go to TA bill, and you will be good. Her practice questions and exams are really helpful and so are examples given in class.

She does come off very strict and mean, but honestly, I enjoyed her lectures. They were interesting and she gave many examples that I was able to relate to. She did brutally scold me during a one-on-one meeting for "memorizing" my way through the class, and I was very sad :( but afterwards I changed my study methods and improved a lot on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The TA's helped me get through this class. Drop you're ego at the door. Do the textbook reading, GO TO CLASS, go to recitation and TA office hours. Generous Curve. It isn't all that bad but if you have another option take that one instead!!

Bhiladwalla is a funny and good professor if you attend lecture and recitation. She will publicly berate you if you're late but her class is easier than the other section. Saying that she's bad means you didn't go to lecture where she tells you everything on the test and explains the material in depth multiple times. You get what you give.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MB is effective and good at teaching. She is very harsh and will belittle and publicly shame students that come in late to lecture, are talking, or on their phone. With that being said, if you can manage to come on time and stay off your phone, she is totally worth it. Her curves were fair, study guides helpful, and the homework was easy.

Eveyrone that is giving her a 1 is tweaking. The class isn't super easy but as long as your ego isn't super fragile and your fine showing up to class on time and not going on your phone I would take this class. As long as you show up and do the readings you will do well and the curve was like 7% this year, so not that hard to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I recommend going to EVERY recitation.. I also ended up getting tutored for the final, which helped a lot. The material is not hard; the wording on the tests is just very confusing (it's all multiple choice). Sometimes I felt like the questions were set up to purposely trick u. But if you fully know the material, you will be okay. don't fall behind

If you decide to take her, gg. I was once in ur position, i read the reviews and took the gamble. I paid the price, do not take the gamble, avoid this infinitely discouraging professor. The best part of this class was that I did not have to attend. other than that, good luck.

she's condescending and her lectures are just slides however she does teach pretty well so it's helpful to actually attend the lectures. Her tests are all mcq although the wording is often weird and confusing. Her TAs are good too. the 2 midterms and final make up 88% of your grade.

She posts some slides, doesn't post others, you don't know when you have to come to class. Her practice tests are not like the actual ones. She goes very fast, blows through 60 slides in 1 SITTING. I must say, she does give you chapters and stuff of that to know, but she always does some weird twist on tests.

Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had at NYU thus far. Her tone in delivering class content and answering questions is incredibly condescending- she will make it a point to humiliate you instead of helping you understand what you're wondering. I personally stopped showing up to lectures mid-semester.

Horrible. HORRIBLE. She does not know how to spell, her questions on the test are unclear. If you go to her for feedback she will just yell at you. DO NOT TAKE!!!!! The other reviews are real. She is horrible.

Run!!! Pretty much what everyone said tbh. If you need it for your major, take it next semester or change major like i did (she could be helpful, but if you're not doing well, she'll tell you econ is not for you and to change your major)....If she's your only option, all I can say is pray! If you don't have a religion, pick one and start praying.

All the RMP reviews for this class sum it up really well. The class isn't easy by any means but Prof. Bhiladwalla is fair. She'll explain what's on the exam and leaves lecture slides up when they discuss tricky concepts. Cannot emphasize enough how important it is to go to lectures and actually pay attention! That'll be your best test prep.

Her lectures are meandering and do a poor job of explaining fairly simple concepts. Tests are extremely difficult and have little resemblance to practice material and in-class content. Avoid taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought my life was over but I went to her office hours and she helped pass so thank her for that
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Bhiladwalla is fine. Since I took econ in high school I found this class easy as it was a review for me, but if I had no prior knowledge of economics I would have been very lost. She is funny but not always good at completly explaining the concepts. If you miss one lecture she will not go over it again, so attendance is pretty important.

She's the reason I'm pass failing and retaking the course later. She's good at teaching but she can ask about things she hasn't gone over in the exams. Her midterms are mcq's but are very difficult nonetheless. The class is interesting but it will tank your gpa if you're not blessed with micro skills by the gods. DON'T TAKE HER!!! You'll thank me.

She's a good teacher, not a great person. She teaches the material well for sure if you go to class regularly but she's hella mean if u come to class late/use ur phone its kinda OD. Exams are hard for sure but if you go to class often she tells you a lot of whats on the exam. Homework is light just mcq's.

The exams are pretty hard, but curved. Exams may be curved DOWNWARDS (94 was an A- on Ex1). If you skip lecture, make sure you get good notes from someone.
