reviews.comment: Professor Khera is very knowledgable only in her field of Art History which is South East Asian Art. I took this class for Global Cultures credit and couldn't be happier that it finished. Her lectures make no sense at all neither do her assignments. Total waste of Tuition and she is very rude as well. Basically taught myself the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Foundations of Art History, is not foundations at all- only her very niche knowledge. Very harsh, and terrible lectures. She also has a very thick accent that is difficult to understand.

Took foundations of art history since I was going to major in art history. However, professor Khera only knows subjects related to Southeast Asian arts. She is terrible at teaching broader context of art history and her lectures are extremely tedious. She was unkind and rude to students who were asking questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Khera's Foundations of Art History class is labeled wrong. It is not a foundations of art history, it is a small niche of East Asian art and whatever pieces Professor Khera wants to teach about. The lectures are long and boring, filled with nonsense ramblings. The readings are lengthy and pointless, adding absolutely nothing. Bad class.

Professor Khera seemed to be great at first glance. However, the readings she gave were extremely long and often quite difficult. Her lectures were not engaging even though I did readings. Also, she was rude to students who asked questions that were not in her favor. Also, there's leas detailed feedbacks for assignments, especially essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I came into this class as an aspiring art history major, now I want to leave CAS. Professor Khera's class taught me less about art history than my high school ones... that says a lot despite the egregious amount of reading she assigns every class. Soooo lengthy and difficult to understand that most of my recitation stopped doing them mid-semester

She was rude to students who asked questions, taught random East Asian pieces, and did not give a good overview of Art History at all. I though I wanted to major in Art History, but her and her guest lecturers were all so snobby and annoying I now know it is not the field for me.

Do NOT take this class if you don't have to for your major. She rambles about her own personal interests and practically refuses to take student imput. No computer policy for first two months but her TA was allowed to knit everyday in the front row - more distracting than computers. No conclusive points to lectures and subjective grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She has very few ideas about the content except for Southeast Asian art and is sometimes mean. I took this class to build a basis for art history, and it didn't help at all. The midterm exam is not based on knowledge of artworks because you do not need to memorize the artworks, artists, and dates, but the names and quotes of the articles assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Khera is caring, considerate, and humorous. However if you are not majoring in art history dont ever take ARTH UA 10. There are a lot of readings assigned for each class, very difficult to keep up. There were too many contents in the lecture, just too overwhelming. She focuses on architecture and southeast asian art, if you care to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Khera is really knowledgeable and a cool teacher if you are very interested in South Asian Art History. If you aren't an art history major on the other hand, you should probably not take this class. Her workload is okay but not easy.

(South Asian Art: 1200-Present) Prof. Khera is caring and hilarious and knows what she is talking about. Her essay prompts are dense with information (think one page), so you do have to sift thru them to understand what you should be writing about. You go on class museum visits with her & she is super passionate. I would definitely take it again!

She is a sweet professor. However she makes an intro class to art history difficult to follow and she is a tough grader. The prompts for papers are extremely long and confusing, you need to put in A LOT of effort to get an A on papers. If you need to take an intro art history class don't take this class. You need to work unnecessarily very hard.

Professor Khera was okay. The class wasn't too hard, but I did not like the way she graded. She clearly had biases toward certain students, and I was actually shocked to see how she gave my friend extra credit on the quiz to give her the 90, when there was no such extra credit. My friend was shocked too, bc she didn't even study for her quizzes.

Professor Khera is absolutely fabulous! The way in which she teaches clearly reflects her enthusiasm about South Asian Art. Her organization of the course is very straightforward, and the lectures are always interesting. This being said, the class is quite lecture heavy, and you should go to every class. It make the quizzes and papers easier.
